Peter,

My father taught me that all we have can be quickly taken away if we're not careful, and that we must care for one another because we rise and fall together.

**Washington is facing a crisis, and our shortage of affordable housing is leaving people without their basic needs.**

As commissioner of public lands, I knew I had to find an innovative way to put the Department of Natural Resources to use to uplift those in need. For the first time in the agency's history, we started to build affordable housing on public land, but I didn't stop there.

**During my time as commissioner, I've found ways to expand our agency to put it to work, addressing our people's most pressing challenges.** From providing funding for our schools and public services to finding innovative solutions to affordable housing, I've shown how to bring our state together to tackle our challenges. clean_body: My father taught me that all we have can be quickly taken away if we're not careful, so we must care for one another and rise and fall together. | = Peter, My father taught me that all we have can be quickly taken away if we're not careful, and that we must care for one another because we rise and fall together. Washington is facing a crisis, and our shortage of affordable housing is leaving people without their basic needs. As commissioner of public lands, I knew I had to find an innovative way to put the Department of Natural Resources to use to uplift those in need. For the first time in the agency's history, we started to build affordable housing on public land, but I didn't stop there. During my time as commissioner, I've found ways to expand our agency to put it to work, addressing our people's most pressing challenges. From providing funding for our schools and public services to finding innovative solutions to affordable housing, I've shown how to bring our state together to tackle our challenges. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Hilary Franz | | As Washington Commissioner of Public Lands, Hilary Franz took bold action to defend our lands and bring people together to solve statewide issues, like increasing funding for our schools, investing in economic development and tackling our wildfire crisis. subject: New: Threads may be the next ground zero for election disinformation
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FAIR FIGHT ACTION
body:
Meta has yet to publish their policies for combating the spread of harmful election disinformation on Threads. |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68827904/424242448/1793776944?ms=bsc_emm_ffa_20230828_e_disinfoarticle_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTZmNjYxYS0wMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0j9MOpGVy78YXLrRL14xvgr9CYOOsk-L03FHaDiXNGA=&emci=9fdb5f14-0146-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=196f661a-0146-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1037277)

| | Are you on Threads? Whether you’re a frequent user or just hearing about it for the first time now, we want to catch you up on growing concerns over how Threads — or any other shiny new social media platforms — will impact our democracy. Meta, the company that owns Facebook and Instagram, launched their latest social network Threads this summer — a platform for sharing text-based posts, photos, and short videos. In the first few days after its launch, it accumulated tens of millions of users — gaining a reputation as the fastest-growing app in history. **But it might also gain notoriety as the next ground zero for election disinformation.** Nearly two months later, and with local election cycles in full swing around the country, Meta _still_ hasn’t released their policies or plan for combating the spread of harmful election disinformation on Threads. As we’ve seen on social media platforms like Facebook in past elections, Threads users could share false claims about voting and candidates — and those posts could go viral, ultimately manipulating voters and impacting voter turnout. To top it off, recent reports show that Meta laid off staff from its teams that handle election disinformation. Whether you’re a frequent user or just hearing about it for the first time now, we want to catch you up on growing concerns over how Threads — or any other shiny new social media platforms — will impact our democracy. Meta, the company that owns Facebook and Instagram, launched their latest social network Threads this summer — a platform for sharing text-based posts, photos, and short videos. In the first few days after its launch, it accumulated tens of millions of users — gaining a reputation as the fastest-growing app in history. But it might also gain notoriety as the next ground zero for election disinformation. Nearly two months later, and with local election cycles in full swing around the country, Meta still hasn’t released their policies or plan for combating the spread of harmful election disinformation on Threads. While I have a great "Only in America " story to tell on the campaign trail, the fact of the matter is that I wouldn't be in the strong position to win the Republican nomination to the U.S. Senate that I am in today if it weren't for the folks who have supported this critical mission from DAY ONE. We’ve worked extremely hard to secure support from the above-listed folks. And I’m grateful beyond measure to have it because it was never guaranteed, which is why I’ll never take it for granted. I’m the candidate who will finally send Sen. Jon Tester out to pasture once and for all. If you’ve been hesitant to endorse my candidacy when we’ve asked before, it’s my hope that seeing some familiar names on the list of those who are backing my campaign will nudge you just enough to offer your support as well. With your help, we’re going to beat Jon Tester and flip Montana’s Senate seat Republican and put an end to Chuck Schumer and Jon Tester's agenda. # **_REMINDER_
SEPTEMBER MONTHLY MEETING**
**Tuesday, September 12th, 2023
5:30 PM - 8:00 PM
Red Rock Country Club**
The Active Republican Women of Las Vegas (ARW) invites you to the September monthly meeting. We are off to a fresh start with all new leadership, but we maintain the same passion and commitment that has allowed ARW to be the longest standing Republican Women's Club in Las Vegas (since 1970!).

Who is speaking? We are, and we hope you will, too! We are calling this first meeting our "Town Hall" meeting because we want to hear from you: our members and supporters! We have an exciting lineup of speakers starting with our October meeting, but this meeting is about ARW, its mission, and our vision going forward.

Get your ticket now, as there are _**only 50 spots**_ available!

body:

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.

subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z89q11c76t9077gf5glbc2ardmmvm919q2eal93o_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpg6coj2c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

On June 13th, 2023, political operative Domenic Santana was arrested in front of the Miami courthouse for ambushing President Trump's motorcade as President Trump was leaving his arraignment. Dressed in a striped jail jumpsuit, Domenic held a sign that said, "Lock Him Up." Outside of the Fulton County Jail in Georgia last week the day of President Trump's arrest, Santana was caught on video saying he has visited all of President Trump's indictment sites wearing the jailhouse jumpsuit, escorted by multiple paid actors dressed in rat costumes. Domenic calls these paid actors his "R.A.Ts": Republicans Against Trump.
Following his arrest in Miami, Florida, Santana was charged with disorderly conduct, resisting an officer without violence, and obstructing traffic. According to Santana's[ arrest report,](https://substack.com/redirect/45167582-1aaa-4808-94d7-d374d89e4046?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
> _" The defendant's reckless actions of interrupting the motorcade put the former president's life in danger. The defendant's actions caused the public and media to run toward him, storming the street while the defendant yelled at the Trump supporters as to entice them. After police officers on motorcycles passed by, Santana ran into the middle of the street holding his sign up and blocking the motorcade from proceeding, causing one of the SUVs to swerve to avoid crashing into him", the report stated._
Domenic Santana is the previous owner of the famous New Jersey music club the "Stone Pony", which is known for launching the rock and roll careers of Bon Jovi and Bruce Springsteen. Santana has had many public friendships with the Hollywood and political elite, including former New Jersey Governor Chris Christie and President Barack Hussein Obama.
In a [2012 interview with late night comedian Jimmy Fallon](https://substack.com/redirect/106e5810-f46a-44c0-a862-dfb6f730887b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Christie mentioned Santana's establishment, the Stone Pony.

Cretella and his wife Jeanne are also the owners of the Liberty House Restaurant in Liberty State Park, Jersey City. Cretella is known in the world of New Jersey politics, given the fact that his Liberty House Restaurant, which opened in 2001, has become a popular destination and hotspot for politicians. In 2007, when Barrack Obama was first running for US President, he [had a campaign fundraiser with New Jersey Senator Cory Booker at Cretella's Liberty House restaurant.](https://substack.com/redirect/8c5da5a7-f9eb-44b9-a35e-59723bb371a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [In a 2014 article](https://substack.com/redirect/921dce16-37c0-4c77-874b-b35d84c7308a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it was reported that Chris Christie**** chose Liberty House as the venue for a 50-person dinner to celebrate his second inauguration as Governor of New Jersey. However, due to a "lack of response", the dinner was called off. Along with hosting Chris Christie, Brrack Obama and Cory Booker, Cretella has also hosted other high profile RINO and Democrat politicians and celebrities, including President Bill Clinton, Oprah, Jennifer Lopez, and cast members of the Sopranos.
According to FEC records, Santana's business partner Cretella has donated thousands of dollars over the years to high profile Democrat politicians in the New York and New Jersey area, including Barrack Obama, Senator Cory Booker, Senator Bob Menendez, and disgraced former candidate for mayor of New York City, and registered sex offender Anthony Weiner.

Santana told me to "shut up", and the he shoved his bullhorn in my face and blasted the siren in my ears.
When asked who pays him to attend the pro-Trump events as a disruptor, Santana said he is "wealthy, has a very successful business, and that he's in the hall of fame."
When asked why he was in the vicinity of President Trump, Santana continued, adding on camera that he "is vetted by the White House Advance Team, the Secret Service, and the FBI, and has been through the entire background check."
This is extremely scandalous given the fact that he was arrested for trying to interfere with President Trump's safety. He told me later in the day that he only had to pay $200 to get out of jail in Miami after he was arrested for what would usually be considered a felony in a fair justice system.
Given the fact that Santana's arrest report states that he endangered the life of President Trump, it begs the question, why did Secret Service allow for Santana to be near President Trump, and what type of connections does Santana have that allowed him to evade jail time for ambushing the motorcade of the President of the United States.

| | | | | Peter, A month or two ago I wrote to you with a big announcement: my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is running for Congress in New York’s 19th District – one of the most competitive races in the country. Now I’m back with an even bigger announcement: Josh is running for Congress in one of the most competitive races in the country... AND his wife just had a baby! [While Josh is catching sleep in 30-minute increments and cleaning up spit-up, I’m pitching in to make sure his fundraising doesn’t look like a dirty diaper. So I have to ask, will you split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf4bd8a7d-5380-4f75-846d-d695fbb32f5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

In fact, he’s probably dreaming about taking away someone’s rights, rolling back gun safety legislation or blocking progress on clean energy – he’s only been in Congress a couple of months and he’s already done all that and more! We need someone like Josh in Congress – he’s the real deal. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcef3012f-fc2d-4047-a3d2-babe50437b53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
(The really tall guy is Josh.) After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh worked on a landmark civil rights lawsuit to help kids from low-income families get access to healthcare. When I was in the Senate, Josh and I passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. And since then, Josh has fought in the Supreme Court to block the Trump Administration’s Muslim Ban and plans to deport Dreamers. Even before he was a dad, Josh was always looking out for the little guy. [So what do you say, Peter? Will you split $15 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Blue Amp Action and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8bc42e0f-faf1-4f83-9aff-38588012b937/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks, Al

| The Gloucester County GOP has just announced that Riley Gaines will be the keynote speaker at the 6th Annual Chairwoman’s Reception! This special event will be happening on Tuesday, September 19th at 6PM at Adelphia Restaurant in Deptford, New Jersey. Learn more and save your spot here. Riley Gaines is a former University of Kentucky swimmer who stepped into the spotlight last year when she first spoke out against men competing in women’s sports. Gaines became a 12-time NCAA All-American swimmer and a five-time SEC champion. But last year, the integrity of her sport — and female sports as a whole — was called into question when University of Pennsylvania swimmer Lia Thomas, who had competed on the school’s men’s team his freshman, sophomore and junior years, began shattering records in the women’s category. Riley can recall wondering why no one was standing up for her or for any women in the room when a man was awarded the 2022 NCAA Women's Swimming Championships. This moment became her call to action: she felt compelled to defend and protect America’s daughters against the woke left and their gender-denying ideology. Riley has actively pursued her mission by speaking at events and making media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s sports and uphold vital truths. I spoke to Riley in our Common Ground podcast. Listen to her story HERE. Everything that Riley Gaines stands for is common sense. Click here to learn more about the 6th Annual Chairwoman's Reception that Riley will be headlining as the keynote speaker. Let's come together on September 19th to make a statement, to inspire change, and to take the reins of America's future. We look forward to standing with you. Until next time, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=11bdaa5f83424a8986541bf59968daff&_e=UFZzFD0mbH0FnBE_UiubHGe53ejFMjGdGzUcI0gmp-y5cvviWIyd656eRp0KokEtKB3e7phsCHBk-3GHd2p5urWMsdVZfZqAK_NIXiCxZ_aE0njpXq9DBIshzVUUS8vD4v9jznMOcYJxheaR-i5gjMIyOU5-gqFzpfZ_FU2JBchTVhzAm0g43hXzA7VjoL8Yl5TuDDkTsYI58dfrQPf-dYrXyoi2Xuk9WbjOCHdIh8eH2t20RLH05j52wokQuAIzgpoYgfMTlm8m8kkpvrOcZshDjMz3_8oDbqr2CxVXF9B4b9zqG9tdKJRigmNzRbQJEEtIrvHHjfandQ008RujxlkBhKhXtk29FtDxWdrQDwlCAUl-0VBpyAuBT5CIDbkwxr9n9owQodUBlr9T1yPgeybHzTrXE7BvdtcXgZED1_o%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=11bdaa5f83424a8986541bf59968daff&_e=UFZzFD0mbH0FnBE_UiubHGe53ejFMjGdGzUcI0gmp-y5cvviWIyd656eRp0KokEtKB3e7phsCHBk-3GHd2p5urWMsdVZfZqAK_NIXiCxZ_aE0njpXq9DBIshzVUUS8vD4v9jznMOcYJxheaR-i5gjMIyOU5-gqFzpfZ_FU2JBchTVhzAm0g43hXzA7VjoL8Yl5TuDDkTsYI58dfrQPf-dYrXyoi2Xuk9WbjOCHdIh8eH2t20RLH05j52wokQuAIzgpoYgfMTlm8m8kkpvrOcZt7T4dFVG3h8d2fGJhKgjidauV6gf33U15xN-2Damxntax5EN2DqALTkZWuYxEjfXvjctF83w1XqiMYa4ORF3RQgeNTh4Q6WuMCrWZ1s_KOSaro2zb999sZIjd6C3NF_aXPKKqNjdVe5oTEkqD5ezyc%3D) If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

clean_body: Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of "The Second World Wars " on DVD: Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! August 29, 2023 Back in the fall of 2022 I wrote an article titled "Free Speech is Suffocating Under Blue-Captured Connecticut's 'Iron Cloak' of Corporate Media." It was picked up and published by the [CT Examiner](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001I3KzqAO0Mf4WxEXsclSDFbwM81LB-3PUjdjXqdL_LM5eRcIfXeK5Ka99FxFV-ZMx4kSZdqXC9JtW6UlV2izrwHiDybZEOAWQyuZP0l63fjnv8MG7PrwTAxMuH__icWmcy9SmUjSodRzAK8iDg67s-dCKDW5QjO48tvZ2vJhoC7pmG5tCmaoxna6yjW0Vv_gh_VfvQ0IGJzRAMwILwVY8oSP-4rCF-3jIvpag4tptUDsaIR1tm4MRZfPcMAmrObgZ8kuFP97TwDEr_aQriP3IiAQInvzpnprr&c=FShhqEFeOlaF8ZGGqc7J9xI07d0QggNhqpUva_niLwcjG1JVY1VDNw==&ch=dWqMT7lWDlsOPbRKG6Fgne1vfYS1cmWOybr1UayeAADUzKjy26NIag==), [The Connecticut Centinal](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001I3KzqAO0Mf4WxEXsclSDFbwM81LB-3PUjdjXqdL_LM5eRcIfXeK5Ka99FxFV-ZMx705ns1N_b_4kPCu44kNn5cIi7x2-_kl5SUrTpbRthOZxzAvIT1Z6Vpa8Ur_xmtSxbqt7HxTOevnzsm5iaMOmnJd_g9yV9kcv42er3IcIkkxZaYLJFVvLApXwvbqQCr833WTrqBLnb3z3r-vTObR3M8iEL7J_wik9loCenaC07Hs-NhgjMMuFXlqZI5-rqZMajPRDFpeyzeBVegckA8qHFg==&c=FShhqEFeOlaF8ZGGqc7J9xI07d0QggNhqpUva_niLwcjG1JVY1VDNw==&ch=dWqMT7lWDlsOPbRKG6Fgne1vfYS1cmWOybr1UayeAADUzKjy26NIag==) and [The Continental Tribune](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001I3KzqAO0Mf4WxEXsclSDFbwM81LB-3PUjdjXqdL_LM5eRcIfXeK5Ka99FxFV-ZMxXp8eZ3V-Uc_PhNXDoHxtTwYp1nNg3cDzxPtAH-btU0q2FEle5gMdYc20IWc9kmMFvpOqrcLAKfxqkjHNhjlFkZCL4OwBNxhD5_N2Pke08Wg_w0hP7Vbtt7cd8dX1Ai1U4YifCc5RSzCaxqUipLMrCvqVRDe3jApLJVE3FwQNktCKlMiZng8z9Kyx1auz3jITggPSvvO2Hf-5ehsYP8dNR8MbCN9oKyRnUlJcPdRHyQbxl0SGvSWf-g==&c=FShhqEFeOlaF8ZGGqc7J9xI07d0QggNhqpUva_niLwcjG1JVY1VDNw==&ch=dWqMT7lWDlsOPbRKG6Fgne1vfYS1cmWOybr1UayeAADUzKjy26NIag==). These three are genuinely independent publications, but cover state-wide stories and events. The background is that six years ago, the huge and sprawling Hearst Media corporation established Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) to acquire CT media properties. HCMG now owns nine daily newspapers, 13 weekly papers and CT Magazine. Though some have state-wide reach, most are centered in, and focused on Fairfield County. The acquired news outlets range from the larger Connecticut Post and Stamford Advocate, to town papers such as the Trumbull Times and New Canaan Advertiser. In Connecticut's 4th Congressional District alone, Hearst has acquired the leading town/city paper in 13 of the 17 towns in the district. Unless you're in Monroe, Oxford, Redding, or Weston, your town's paper is owned by Hearst Media. With its editorials and story slant, Hearst has proven itself as no friend of the free-speech rights of Republicans, or any citizen on the right side of the political spectrum. In the Hearst local papers there's little commenting allowed on editorials or op-eds, and only subscribers can comment on some articles the editor deems open for comment. Many won't take letters-to-the-editor or op-eds from the general public either - you need to be someone credentialed. There's also a single editorial board and a couple writers who pen the editorials, which appear in all the town papers simultaneously. The editorials provide a steady diet of progressivism, with regular salvos of ridicule sprinkled in for anyone among the public who speaks out against the progressive corporate or establishment line. Because of this arrangement, free-speech here in Fairfield County, and indeed much of Connecticut, has now been effectively suffocated. The couple truly-independent local media outlets are practically drowned out of the community conversation and the reporting of news. In four towns of our 4th District, the remaining ostensibly 'independent' town papers largely echo the establishment/corporate view in their news coverage. | | Peter,

Government can’t use its investigatory power to punish citizens’ speech. We're going to prove it in court, which is why I'm suing Keith Ellison and the Minnesota Board of Medical Practice. [Please watch](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=83c7ca342f&e=9828080a05) this critical update from James Dickey, my attorney at the Upper Midwest Law Center, by [clicking the thumbnail below:](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=5db57ab819&e=9828080a05)

| As I've said before, this lawsuit will bring a new precedent for what the role of licensing boards - especially when it comes to policing free speech outside of the purview of your professional role.

This is especially important as rhetoric ramps up around another potential COVID pandemic. What we saw in 2020 and 2021 cannot become the norm. Doctors and other professionals must have the freedom to oppose the prevailing narrative. We saw teachers, nurses, doctors, and other professionals lose their job just because they spoke their mind.

This lawsuit is so critical in establishing new guidelines for discourse. Please [watch this video update](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=a2b688b050&e=9828080a05), share it, and (if you have the ability), [help fund this lawsuit](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=09cccf182e&e=9828080a05) against Keith Ellison and the Minnesota Board of Medical Practice.

[If it can happen to me, it can happen to you.](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=fa4ae991f0&e=9828080a05)

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

August 29, 2023
Dear Friend,
Today, Tuesday, August 29, is Election Day in Knoxville. Please get to vote
and support our endorsed candidates, Debbie Helsey and Cameron Brooks.
Debbie Helsley is running for Knoxville City Council At Large Seat B. She's poured her energy into giving back to her community for decades. Debbie is a former union president and neighborhood organizer. We believe fully that she will carry the same energy into elected office to fight for a Knoxville that represents every neighborhood, background, and zip code. We need someone like her in office to continue building progressive power in Knoxville, the Appalachia, and our state.
Cameron Brooks is running for Knoxville City Council At Large Seat A. He has long been a champion for working families, having spent a decade serving as an Organizer with the United Campus Workers. Cameron has a long history of public service at the grassroots level, as an Election Commissioner and animal-rights advocate. We're confident that he will bring the same commitment to his community to the Knoxville City Council.
SUPPORT TENNESSEE VOTER PROJECT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]

At Shift WA, we are committed to exposing the real reason behind our state's record-high gas prices. Unlike mainstream media sources, we have been working hard to challenge various Democrat attempts to hide the truth since the start of Inslee administration over a decade ago. Friend, **Newly uncovered documents show that Joe Biden was NOT acting in line with U.S. policy as VP when he threatened to withhold aid to Ukraine until Prosecutor General Viktor Shokin was fired!**
**_This was all happening while Shokin was aggressively investigating corruption by Burisma Holdings, who paid Hunter Biden over $1,000,000._**
This is huge. It completely undercuts the Democrats narrative going all the way back to 2019 when they used it as the pretense to impeach President Trump.
| [ **DEFEND COMER** ](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=0b5ced240a9f4c44b21609329a8d7c91&_e=asUBLFiR43xutuDllfqp4zoqkAi6U82z9Fiht3MNj7mj66mQAX152eX5ZOoE9-MsAPWGl0cRAoZjAnxJY0ctFWYK7Du1DcVmunP4HBr_jcSAUdL_PE8Ci8IpkEQQ5b6cwJCvNd_nY4jfr5bvwVFY_MObAJX3lGV8uPKSSG7uirHtcSdYTnFDt-XZgFoEr4cyesNHnqiWsqigpCwXRS2E5JbTIsZ1shkJbEAxQIdDGqBkNHVf5tArV1akPLEsAtKAhzSAs6mFvl-2D_unwBsj3U7IZTYjrnAqmimSPQp4gYvJHCJD5B2CZASwQijoTFDw)

An October 2015 memo summarizing the recommendation of the Interagency Policy Committee (a task force created to advise the Obama White House on whether Ukraine was cleaning up its endemic corruption and deserved more Western foreign aid) **shows that U.S. policy did not call for a threat to withhold funding****!** Biden made the threat in December 2015, two months after the memo was published, and no other documents show the U.S. policy called for Shokin to be fired. On top of that, State Department officials sent Viktor Shokin a personal note saying they were "impressed" with his office's work to clean up corruption and even invited his staff to Washington in January of 2016 for a "strategy session". **And don 't forget, sworn testimony from Devon Archer holds that Burisma was putting constant pressure on Hunter Biden to "get help from Washington" regarding Viktor Shokin.** Democrats can't hide from this much longer, the truth is coming out, whether they like it or not.
| [ **DEFEND COMER** ](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=0b5ced240a9f4c44b21609329a8d7c91&_e=asUBLFiR43xutuDllfqp4zoqkAi6U82z9Fiht3MNj7mj66mQAX152eX5ZOoE9-MsAPWGl0cRAoZjAnxJY0ctFWYK7Du1DcVmunP4HBr_jcSAUdL_PE8Ci8IpkEQQ5b6cwJCvNd_nY4jfr5bvwVFY_MObAJX3lGV8uPKSSG7uirHvQfsZ6hz_OCEAtfG_Gf6NvcDhgw3EmlTd_IVZkW4ge9FRywKzM7jYw1gMZIAX9dvF9YxPBg4Xpo9B1Sa8Wr576Xs-1xsaoZMTXps_P6pkFkGhw70QutJA6Cl9kMr-6fgpDtNT5pijtBumOXQeUeb4)
---
This is backed up by an audio tape of a conversation between Ukrainian President Poroshenko and VP Biden from March 2016. Poroshenko told Biden **" Despite of the fact that we didn't have any corruption charges, we don't have any information about him doing something wrong, I especially asked him ... No, it was the day before yesterday. I especially asked him to resign".** This new evidence makes Biden's 2019 claim that he "did nothing wrong" and "carried out the policy of the United States government in rooting out corruption in Ukraine" even more suspect. _**Nobody, including Joe Biden, has come forward with a plausible explanation for why Shokin was fired ...**_ _**... which is exactly why the media and Democrats are attacking me so aggressively.**_ It's exhausting to be constantly attacked and smeared by the Democrats and their allies in the media. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5bmkjko9j70ba0hv3o0ffdh37l85i9u0hck82mg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t34mlrm0pr1cqp32olm64r63cb4siq3cpdkm2r35c3jclqrccpjm1p32tlke1jrfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj35cljcorr5c36elgb6p77m2qmash1k8gn48n24hhm9pj6c9ge2oj4s8iv0)

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z34o8c126p7cuglsnvsjb836gqs62ig61nh4pdd8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfe072f3qnt7b62n205mtkq3kcsit01davo6b6eg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsph67g90bn387q0dqjf0olh6v3qc2r1vnh5hhhg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2znbvi8sfg8n3jh52mskh3ao8fvc6hfq8v1uheejg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z008jtu25vcefk1qa7v1vgl0uj0uc2hdrq2ecuo0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zqe2p8d3aip3d3iaprau1163o81o41e33b45hf6g_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?

---
| | [CHIP IN $5](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4ktm0vr4cr890ralnhtcj9j6de8giq572rdg77o_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $25](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmmhg7t1p2dq3gq2ugcqekj3tfe6e6q0brle5ri0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $50](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z56prn5qr1io0eopkrolu1hc5ekt0o6h5kfu9hk8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $150](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0gk1bd9iaegub6qumhphsvbb6bj16r8a7aep7l8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN ANY OTHER AMOUNT](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zr6lhiptmqagbnccobebbm4mrft80dmhrurf8rpg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help to make it across the finish line- starting right now.](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zec8og2ukh2i9imdfmep06id6478bo18c27vraro_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "I need your help â€“ starting right now. ")**

Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
| [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zv7qjlrg3fcoe0gd59m0tf48akqmbgbk39usjl70_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs)

Nikki Haley

| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zdkirnljcbrf7sd4qdcsrkadggk73r1f81h5jm78_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---

---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0cpq6q23d6k32pvga7dgi4eqni9r0ckq3r0v3e0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhiifn3hgrf8h00pm4ivl5o6ecstr9m8ctl692m0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61ob2cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

name: Nikki Haley
subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zot96slrm47ebem182h3eu8u8kci3tm30nncgopo_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61p76cjh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb6k6f71vrfjkvjfle76qt80o9h8lg2pb1hf0m6g_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61p76cjh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo4g0nj7a1edir896sk4lalb0qj3uab2g672f3ng_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61p76cjh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2btre25c4b66ud0rl3gogv7vf6qf2j0pqv90ico_rp22sh2s8i66p76cph61p76cjh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,
---

body:
She’ll raise a ton of money, and then she’ll go back to DC and vote against the people she represents.
#

Peter,
I’m going to take a risk today, and tell you something you probably already know:
Kyrsten Sinema raises almost all of her money from the wealthy and well-connected because that’s who she uses her power and the privilege of her office to protect.
She took in a ton of money from the airlines, and then she supported legislation to weaken training requirements that keep pilots and flyers safe.
She took in a ton of money from millionaires and billionaires who are against raising the minimum wage, and then she gave her infamous thumbs-down on a bill that would have given workers a living wage.
And one month from tonight, she’s going to have another fundraiser. She’ll raise a ton of money, and then she’ll go back to DC and vote against the people she represents.
She has close to $11 million stashed away — a HUGE amount that’s going to get spent on attack ads against me. And she’ll add more to it at that fundraiser.
I need your help to fight back. You are the only way we can compete with her millions.
The people who matter most to this campaign aren’t the ones who can afford to write the biggest checks.
It’s you, Peter. You and thousands of others like you chipping in a little bit at a time. Single moms, small business owners, teachers, librarians, nurses. That’s how we fund our campaign, and that’s how we’ll beat Sinema.

A little more than 6 years ago, Hurricane Harvey hit Houston, proving to be the second costliest storm in U.S. history.
Many of our most vulnerable residents (low-income seniors) remain in need. I have worked over these past 6 years to meet residents where they are to deliver help.
I wrote an Op-Ed in today’s Houston Chronicle [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/opinion/outlook/article/amanda-edwards-harvey-hurricane-houston-students-18334716.php] , calling for a renewed effort toward a more equitable and full recovery.

As a City Council Member, citizen, and as your next Congresswoman, I will keep families in our community impacted by Harvey at the forefront and lead the effort to ensure there is a full recovery for our residents.
Onward,

Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8inkrlac91s240gpfc3r71i94dn9qmbp6c70n80_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj60oj0clh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze08cqbg5tg9saas1h975pbs91edlnljb7a0dk68_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj60oj0clh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjt41c9lg1sptiih9ujltv79iemkgioltvpprne0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj60oj0clh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze6k799ssfrma3a9epiv6grvrbhinesf4jcc8cqg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj60oj0clh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

body:

---

---
| |
**Dear Friend** ,

Across Long Island, the kids will soon be heading back to school. It’s an exciting and bittersweet time for parents as they are reminded that our children are always growing up right before our eyes.

We care deeply about education in my household. My wife, Carol, is a longtime public school teacher, and it saddens and angers us that the public education system is increasingly becoming a front line in the right-wing culture war. It’s an outrage to watch states like Texas and Florida look to ban books, censor teachers, and edit history books to the point of promoting outright falsehoods. During the Republican presidential debate, attacks on the very idea of public education were met with applause.

[Please donate so that I can fight for teachers and students against radicals who would deny that education is a universal right in this country. ](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=9ec63a8371&e=a6aa651d40)

School is an extremely important part of how our kids are raised. They spend lots of time there, and teachers can be towering figures in their young lives. That’s why it’s so important that we resist efforts to distort history by extremists who would deny the significance of major historical events and periods such as chattel slavery or the Holocaust.

[In Congress I will fight to preserve fact-based curriculums that ensure our students learn history, even when it is unpleasant. Will you donate to stand with me on this issue?](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=ca83edd802&e=a6aa651d40)

When we teach our kids falsehoods instead of facts, we also hurt the development of their critical thinking skills and their ability to distinguish reality from propaganda. This is not how we ought to raise our kids – and it sets our country on a dangerous path. And we will discourage the best and brightest teachers from staying in the classrooms, at a time when they are needed more than ever.

[We need to have our students and teachers’ backs, and I promise that I always will. Please send a donation of any amount if you agree that education is extremely important.](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=77aa2e68c4&e=a6aa651d40)

I’ll fight on the frontlines so that our teachers, students, and parents can focus on what matters – passing the benefits of a great education on to the next generation.

Best,
Jim

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century. The America I see has the courage and confidence to defend our values and defeat our enemies. In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever. In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela. We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia. And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose... Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history! Realizing this vision won't be easy. Teammates, As summer comes to a close, my schedule has been _packed_ these last two weeks. And I wanted to share some highlights:
* Went to the Ravens' and Commanders' training camps 🏈 – I'm making the case that the Commanders should continue to play and _win_ in PG county
* Visited the 🏥 Women's Health Center in Western Maryland to thank them for all they do – they moved here after West Virginia banned virtually all abortion care
* Attended the Maryland Associations of Counties Conference in the beautiful Ocean City 🦀 – I'm building partnerships with our local electeds and doing the work to get our economy growing and make this Maryland's decade
* Took Tucker 🐶 to the SPCA of Anne Arundel's puppy plunge – we made some great new friends who are adorable AND adoptable

Now, I'm proud of all that travel, and I wouldn't change it for the world. Because it's how I fulfill my role as governor of Maryland and make sure we leave no one behind. **But... It means we haven't been hitting our fundraising as hard as we could. And that's not something we can afford to leave behind either, team.** [**So I'm asking you right now to pitch in and help close our fundraising gap before August is over. Dear friend,

I hope you are well and enjoying your summer. I am reaching out to invite you to an event in support of someone you may have met in my congressional office, at one of my many town hall and political events, or in your neighborhood picking up your kids from school - my former District Office Director, Mitchelle Drulis. Mitchelle is running for our New Jersey State Assembly in the 16th legislative district - which covers a big part of my old 7th district.

The 16th District race will be one of the most hotly contested in New Jersey in this year’s legislative elections. And Mitchelle will be a wonderful Assemblywoman. As my District Director, she helped literally thousands of people — working one person at a time — to solve problems and get better service from our federal government. She will be your representative in Trenton in the truest sense of the word. I’m also convinced she has the integrity and independence to try to make politics in New Jersey work better for everyone.

The event will be in Princeton at 5:30 PM on Monday, September 18th. I’ll be there, too, so I hope to see you! Details are below, where you can RSVP.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/9.18princeton [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/9.18princeton]

I look forward to seeing you there!

Tom

Friend,

If you didn't get to watch the debate, I want to make sure you know my story.

I've been underestimated in every race I've run. But I've never lost a race, and I'm not starting now. **[That's why I'm asking you to chip in today and help me win this fight.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7944145de5e548f091cc334730c6463a&_e=iUV5yLQyouaBFW6xleSnDX__hS2wGCFKq-4kMOdKkBTRM9I4ziyLiFGSV6LfsMhVsloDL1KgG0E_ASNB6k-3pnYAm1wrPndZvXYP4G-QlEBE7jr573o9utOba1ZW3-duxComaDbfcLmyeJhGaI1vbYAJuk4PN0YXfYoFlnumOk-el6b4nx1xOu_8x1hhIHamLr-p29OwENt0xJzPAe2gXSVfpeoAAJ21MkUCH-6Su5N5-1Xt0UsQuaakSU1AMsFVUbsGAEXjuE5e_dhRbk6Cczp2f4KphErRIQ0AEFaLFv3B9FafLjYtDxSbGmJrsepc5stKjZWrmWS9ie6BoA-NSkF_gH-6xJ0dQcMYXvkYBbvqxN08-BJKJnDG8VZS9oLTHaaOZTlEuj-VgqtSBrRAe9yiSZABRVKmFVv39brrNb0g_j2DLnsd80--7isiOy2IjaX8bbeRa9tajr9ymfBZhNXBL1t1QRe_EJwTZqEcIDkIMqFlG48MdCwczPei-cdEZ83W32jZEBOn5Xcjz_b8Sz-Hv9VzgGt-OE1MZparLeMYrTnUcKNb2XL1GUWNRXUTcJzVVP4fjSOQKfSYI4Jrf0D7Gv50nJYmcqVdxsNZ1Sg%3D "That’s why I’m asking you to chip in today and help me win this fight. ")**

When I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state, no one said I had a shot. A week before the primary, I was polling at 15 percent.

_**But together, we won.**_

When I ran for governor, people asked, "Nikki who?" I was polling in fourth place with just a few months until Election Day. I was the least funded, and least known GOP candidate in the race.

_**But together, we won.**_

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7944145de5e548f091cc334730c6463a&_e=iUV5yLQyouaBFW6xleSnDX__hS2wGCFKq-4kMOdKkBTRM9I4ziyLiFGSV6LfsMhVsloDL1KgG0E_ASNB6k-3pnYAm1wrPndZvXYP4G-QlEBE7jr573o9utOba1ZW3-duxComaDbfcLmyeJhGaI1vbYAJuk4PN0YXfYoFlnumOk-el6b4nx1xOu_8x1hhIHamLr-p29OwENt0xJzPAe2gXSVfpeoAAJ21MkUCH-6Su5N5-1Xt0UsQuaakSU1AMsFVUbsGAEXjuE5e_dhRbk6Cczp2f4KphErRIQ0AEFaLFv3B9FafLjYtDxSbGmJrsepc5stKjZWrmWS9ie6BoA-NSkF_gH-6xJ0dQcMYXvkYBbvqxN08-BJKJnDG8VZS9oLTHaaOZTlEuj-VgqtSBrRAe9yiSZABRVKmFVv39brrNb0g_j2DLnsd80--7isiOy2IjaX8bbeRa9tajr9ymfBZhO-DrJbpSBhTA8us48chf67ZOBveTsRV0ZFKRvdKmq8RAOtxtPZeg7oG9o6cZIGevmq1cOAjeyfdzcNy2cORtJqaddtGDyJqKy3PnwgjQ0OmC9glpXWZGA6N8TyvyTCGL5NC3QSWVAQ2D4VZltUBd-0%3D)
---

Then we cut taxes, created thousands of jobs, and revitalized our economy. Business journals started calling South Carolina the Beast of the Southeast - which I loved!

When I was nominated for Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. _Then I went to work._ I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

I've been underestimated before. I've been shaking up the status quo my entire life.

**[I'm running for President because our country is on a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction, and we need a leader who has proven time and again that she can rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and focus on serving the people, not the _political class._](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7944145de5e548f091cc334730c6463a&_e=iUV5yLQyouaBFW6xleSnDX__hS2wGCFKq-4kMOdKkBTRM9I4ziyLiFGSV6LfsMhVsloDL1KgG0E_ASNB6k-3pnYAm1wrPndZvXYP4G-QlEBE7jr573o9utOba1ZW3-duxComaDbfcLmyeJhGaI1vbYAJuk4PN0YXfYoFlnumOk-el6b4nx1xOu_8x1hhIHamLr-p29OwENt0xJzPAe2gXSVfpeoAAJ21MkUCH-6Su5N5-1Xt0UsQuaakSU1AMsFVUbsGAEXjuE5e_dhRbk6Cczp2f4KphErRIQ0AEFaLFv3B9FafLjYtDxSbGmJrsepc5stKjZWrmWS9ie6BoA-NSkF_gH-6xJ0dQcMYXvkYBbvqxN08-BJKJnDG8VZS9oLTHaaOZTlEuj-VgqtSBrRAe9yiSZABRVKmFVv39brrNb0g_j2DLnsd80--7isiOy2IjaX8bbeRa9tajr9ymfBZhAzo8mdoiS_uVifCg9zmg3wvpYR5hyQXRejaTX5xdelp5mkWLRuzoIBVikaBtjcqLOGXYHO8-G2BknxtCQheoFf1fw-f-6r0HoRz0mAbwGtOc3npkRYnoY2CwWUTWw1ZVlNr2dUbASpb8EIR8ipo9Rk%3D "I’m running for President because our country is on a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction, and we need a leader who has proven time and again that she can rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and focus on serving the people, not the political class.")**

I'm the daughter of legal immigrants, a proud military wife, the mom of two amazing children, and a grateful citizen who knows our best days are yet to come, if we unite and fight to save our country.

---
| [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7944145de5e548f091cc334730c6463a&_e=iUV5yLQyouaBFW6xleSnDX__hS2wGCFKq-4kMOdKkBTRM9I4ziyLiFGSV6LfsMhVsloDL1KgG0E_ASNB6k-3pnYAm1wrPndZvXYP4G-QlEBE7jr573o9utOba1ZW3-duxComaDbfcLmyeJhGaI1vbYAJuk4PN0YXfYoFlnumOk-el6b4nx1xOu_8x1hhIHamLr-p29OwENt0xJzPAe2gXSVfpeoAAJ21MkUCH-6Su5N5-1Xt0UsQuaakSU1AMsFVUbsGAEXjuE5e_dhRbk6Cczp2f4KphErRIQ0AEFaLFv3B9FafLjYtDxSbGmJrsepc5stKjZWrmWS9ie6BoA-NSkF_gH-6xJ0dQcMYXvkYBbvqxN08-BJKJnDG8VZS9oLTHaaOZTlEuj-VgqtSBrRAe9yiSZABRVKmFVv39brrNb0g_j2DLnsd80--7isiOy2IjaX8bbeRa9tajr9ymfBZhK_JUV22OYmCDKFq1SDeiJ7Kj9_TQMCmYKXfHTcu_2bOyC28pc1YQK7BITYk7Ak7oHqKdSQ1LReI0_KvXrd-sJGoxmYRgMfMzTo_W1NvbLBJ15sZLqxZ6jLUoQLs4BnHEKaWWVKE0_88a_U4jsVQywM%3D)
---

But, saving our country will require us to elect a candidate who not only can defeat Biden and Harris, but one who can lead our country into a brighter future.

When I look to the future, I see America strong once more.

We'll end inflation and build an economy that works for all, just like we did in South Carolina.

In the America I see, every child gets a world-class education - because every parent gets to pick their child's school.

In the America I see, police know we have their backs - criminals know we have their number - and our streets will be safe again!

In the America I see, we stop the surge of drugs and illegal immigration. That means having a real border and mandatory e-verify, like we got done in South Carolina.

In the America I see, everyone has full confidence in our elections. Voter ID will be the law of the land - like I did as governor of South Carolina!

The America I see is freer and better for all.

We'll end corporate welfare and bailouts for big business - and we'll end the earmarks and pork-barrel spending that fuel big government.

And when it comes to our politicians, we'll light a fire under them...Their job is not to say things on TV. Their job is to do things in DC - like solve problems instead of ignoring or creating them!

In the America I see, the permanent politician will finally retire...

We'll have term limits for Congress and we'll have mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75!

Most of all, I see a strong America because I see a proud America.

The future of America is too important to hold back now.

**[I'm running for President of the United States. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zustf968ufacn56h8mvq92kdm8i650dptt2pkhb8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj62pr3cth2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj5vgk4koupl7c75ggtmh03110rkh9ldgjmn5hmo_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj62pr3cth2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8u30n8084e3pfiraug9nncea3m68nsapim12870_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj62pr3cth2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs9udnqefcdjkv8lnkmmv4udcu7aa0jf29bj2rr8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj62pr3cth2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: My story
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I have found that my recovery is very similar to our fight to end gun violence.
#

Friends -
Twelve years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug23.8Y_0mi&refcode=em230829-1-15&t=1&akid=6460%2E3935704%2EhP-PcZ)
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are there in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it hard for me to speak, but I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug23.8Y_0mi&refcode=em230829-1-15&t=2&akid=6460%2E3935704%2EhP-PcZ)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug23.8Y_0mi&refcode=em230829-1-15&t=3&akid=6460%2E3935704%2EhP-PcZ)
I have found that my recovery journey is very similar to our fight to end gun violence. Some days are more difficult than others.
Over the past ten years since GIFFORDS’ founding, I am so proud of the movement we have built and the progress we’ve made towards a future where our communities are safer from gun violence.
But there’s still so much more to be done. Far too many people lose their lives each and every day in America due to preventable gun violence.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug23.8Y_0mi&refcode=em230829-1-15&t=4&akid=6460%2E3935704%2EhP-PcZ)
So this is where I need to ask for your help:
[**Will you contribute $3 to GIFFORDS PAC to help us keep up our work towards a future free from gun violence? With just two days left until our August fundraising drive comes to an end, your support would mean so much to me.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug23.8Y_0mi&refcode=em230829-1-15&t=5&akid=6460%2E3935704%2EhP-PcZ)

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**
August 29, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com ](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com?subject=null&body=null)
**
Tell It Like It Is PAC Launches New Hampshire TV Ad Featuring Governor Chris Sununu**
_Spot Includes Image Of Trump’s Mugshot_
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released a revised version of its latest television ad to include New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu. Entitled “Winning Again,” the :30 second spot is part of a six-figure buy that will air statewide on broadcast and cable in New Hampshire and across digital platforms starting today.
The ad includes footage of Governor Chris Christie and Governor Sununu from a recent town hall in Salem hosted by Tell It Like It Is PAC. Highlighted throughout the ad are the contrasts of the “drama, distraction and lies” around former President Trump. To emphasize this point, Trump’s mugshot from his recent indictment in Fulton County, Georgia is included in the ad.
As U.S. Attorney, Christie won [130 political corruption cases](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=8864e1fd9a&e=d0a9afa930) and successfully tracked down child traffickers and pornographers in New Jersey and [across the globe](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ab0a42a72b&e=d0a9afa930). As governor, he vetoed[ more tax hikes](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=162f6ee388&e=d0a9afa930) than any governor in American history, repealing the estate tax and capping property taxes. His efforts overhauling the Camden Police Department, led to a significant [reduction in crime](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=ecbaf3ce0a&e=d0a9afa930) in what was once the most dangerous city in America - the murder rate has [dropped](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=626e9eb787&e=d0a9afa930) by 74%.
Two recent [public](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=0d533ceccc&e=d0a9afa930) polls released in the Granite State put Governor Christie in sole possession of second place. After two and a half months in the race, Governor Christie has surpassed Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, with [14% of the vote](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=27ad3e2dfb&e=d0a9afa930).
According to Morning Consult, Governor Sununu is the fourth most popular governor in the nation, with a [64% approval rating](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=baf74d6690&e=d0a9afa930).
**“Winning Again”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=a214c8be3a&e=d0a9afa930)
**TRANSCRIPT FOR “WINNING AGAIN” (TV:30):**
**
Voice Over:** _Tired of the drama, the distractions, the lies?_
_It’s time for conservatives to win again._
_Chris Christie._
_A former prosecutor who convicted child pornographers, corrupt politicians._
_A successful blue-state governor._
_Christie took on the teachers’ union and won, turned around Jersey’s most violent city, and got Democrats to cut taxes._
_A real conservative – Christie tells the truth, and he’ll beat Joe Biden - easily._
