body:
Education is on the line! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12648262?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2835adec47&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

Education is on the line. Our children's future is on the line and we are seeing this in schools all across Nebraska. Just recently a strong, conservative Republican Terri Cunningham-Swanson, who is a school board member of Plattsmouth School system had a RECALL attempt to remove her. The reason to remove her? The "reason" was because she stood for the children and the removal of pornography that was in her school system. She stood up for the declining proficiency scores. She stood up for the state statute on Americanism and wanted the students to know the goodness of America. For all this, even some Republicans were a part of this recall. Terri ran on a campaign to protect kids and she has followed through with her promises

**However...yesterday the numbers came back and the recall attempt failed!**

I had Terri speak at our most recent SCC meeting and the membership got to hear her story. Now, I want you to hear her words and what is happening in Nebraska. Terri's situation is not unique. This is what happens when our local School Boards elect those who do not represent our values...YOUR values.

Please meet Terri Cunningham-Swanson...

_1\. Why is it important that these books be either removed or put on a shelf to be checked out with parents’ permission.

Every school district, including PCSD, has standards and policy guidelines that must be followed. I won’t repeat the entire policy here, but it is available to anyone on the PCSD website, Policy 6300. But some basic guidelines are that materials must meet community standards, support the curriculum, not be obscene, excessively vulgar or harmful to minors. Pretty basic and reasonable guidelines.

The books I asked to be reviewed break these guidelines in some way or another. The vast majority is due to very graphic sexual content. And I do mean graphic. The list of books is on the website, too. Parents can check them out for themselves. Then go to a parent run website, such as [booklooks.org](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8927f9afb6&e=25844e23a8) or [ratedbooks.org](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=60f4719b62&e=25844e23a8) to read the content of these books.

The push back has not been very honest. A common retort from people who oppose me has been, “well, if you remove these books, then you have to remove the Bible.” To make a quick comparison, this is how sex is presented in the Bible.

“Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. Gen:4:1

One of the quotes I used in my defense statement was from the book, “Triangles” which is basically a poetry book of multiple, extra-marital sexual encounters.

Nine of the 52 books were by this same author, Ellen Hopkins. I am sorry to repeat this filth, but this is the reality. That book, and many others like it, were in the Plattsmouth High School library. I’m not talking about removing “To Kill A Mockingbird” as has been rumored. This is literary pornography. And I don’t care a single bit if it is graphic heterosexual sex or homosexual sex, it is in no way appropriate to be in a school library.

There are a few books I asked to be reviewed for other reasons. For example, our policy states that if a topic is controversial, we must present both sides. Several books are being reviewed for that reason. But again, the vast majority are due to the obscenity concerns.

2. What misconceptions are going around about your drive to “ban books?”

The most common misconception, is that I am “banning books” at all. Every library purges their shelves on a regular basis. This has happened in the PCSD and even the public library every single year. In fact, the school librarian who made the initial claim that I am “banning books” has gotten rid of books from the same library every year she has worked in the library. Not one single time has anyone called any of these purges a book ban. Every American Civics Committee has made decisions to of what books to purchase, what books not to purchase, and what books need to be removed. Calling this process a book ban is not only disingenuous, it’s a vicious lie meant to stir up vitriol against me for reasons other than reviewing these books. As I said, I am one of 8 school board members who voted to pull the books from the shelves, review them and update Policy 6300. How is it that I am singularly labeled a book banner, a Nazi, an extremist and worse?

Secondly, because it is a favorite talking point of those who are trying to recall me, is that I am targeting minorities and the LGBTQIA+ communities. I touched on this in the last question, I am targeting very graphic, sexual content. It makes no difference the skin color or sexual preference of the characters in the books. Obscenity does not belong in school books. Period.

I think another most common misconception is what I am NOT targeting. I am not concerned with books like “Catcher in the Rye” or “Tom Sawyer”. It is more often those on the ideological side of my opposition who target these classical books.

It’s intellectually dishonest to pretend that age appropriateness is not a real thing or that child development is not a real thing. We can make our children aware of social issues, take sex trafficking for example, which is a hot topic with the movie “Sound of Freedom”. This is probably not a subject to even approach in elementary school. That should be a topic only for parents, if they even choose to address it.

What students, even high school students, do not need, is explicit details of a 50 year old man penetrating a young girl to understand that sex trafficking is bad. This is a reference to the book “Sold”, that is one of those books being reviewed.

I’m not saying we cannot tackle these tough issues or have different views on these different issues represented. But I guarantee we can find books that handle these issues in a much and in a more appropriate way than most of these books do.

3. What are your thoughts about the recall petition?

I have a few thoughts. There seem to be several different groups of people who are involved. The first group I would say, are people who fall into those who believe the misconceptions, because that is what is being told to them. Quite honestly, if I only knew the lies being told about me, I might what to recall myself. But that “book banner extremist” person does not exist. She has been fabricated. Sadly, there are quite a few people who think they know me from these rumors that have been spreading for months now. I have grace for these people whose emotions are being manipulated. But if you are going to cast a vote, for or against someone, you need to take some effort to find out the truth. Since this began, only a handful of people have reached out and talked to me in person. Not all go away agreeing with me, but when they find out the truth, MOST of them do.

Then there is another group of outside agitators. These are people from well outside Plattsmouth who have no vested interest in our schools or our communities. If you do a little digging, you see that these same individuals have launched similar attacks against numerous school board members in various districts. They spend their time trying to intimidate and slander people. At best, they are cowardly keyboard warriors who are part of “cancel culture”. At worst, their actions are very similar to groups like “AntiFa”. I have very little grace and no respect for these people.

The third group, I believe, are people that just don’t like me for one reason or another. Sadly, nearly all of these people do not KNOW me or only know OF me 2nd or 3rd hand from what they have heard or read about me. Unfortunately, several of these people are well known and respected in Plattsmouth, so their opinions carry a lot of weight, even if they are not accurate.

Maybe they don’t like my directness. Maybe they don’t like that I exposed some serious issues in our school. Maybe they don’t like me because I have only lived here for 5 years so I am not a Plattsmouth native. There are lots of reasons, I suppose. My hope would be that these people could set their personal bias aside and look at what I am DOING, not who they think I am.

It makes no sense that every decision the school board has made has been by majority vote. As I stated before, I am the ONLY board member being targeted for a recall. Think about that for a minute. It has to be something other than what people are saying.

Just a thought, but it could even be some board members don’t want me on the board, and and don’t accept the vote of the people of Plattsmouth who put me on their. And this is not unfounded to consider. Of those 8, there are 3 who either personally aligned themselves with the Recall group on Facebook or their spouses or family members did and are actively involved in the recall. Riddle me that?

My final thought regarding the recall is to REALLY THINK CRITICALLY before you make an emotional choice that could be based on very problematic, vague and even blatantly false information. If it is strictly about what you are being told, basically for “banning books”, then there should be a recall of pretty much every single member of the Plattsmouth School Board. Whatever the real reason is behind this recall, voters are not being given the truth. _

With much blessings,

* First, she confirmed anti-choice Trump judges.

body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |

| | |

| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4jtuqc8a8pj91j8kpv9qm41j9nn8ahb59r1uhf8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj66pb0cth2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zinl7u0t4hd8jld6jjebu1nd63nfst8hi4guoft0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj66pb0cth2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztijj5rrvm78u7de2fjfu2qgpsavd93dfd1jr5k0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj66pb0cth2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3vdsoft3abd9jihoifbrobii2d3e5e2jph0de1g_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj66pb0cth2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. name: =?utf-8?Q?Russ=20Vought?=
subject: Jeff asked me to share this message with you
body:
Whatever inversion, whatever destruction, and whatever anti-conservatives forces come at me — or whatever such forces come at Donald Trump.. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10387647?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

I would be lying to you if I said last week wasn’t difficult.

The team here at the Center for Renewing America watched on as our colleague Jeffrey Clark appeared in Fulton County, Georgia along with President Trump and others to face _phony charges_ as part of the 2020 election.

But **Jeff’s refusal to back down** and eagerness to continue the fight against corruption at the highest levels of our government _has become a rallying cry in our office_.

Please [help us stand by Jeff](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f06a248ad2&e=17913c7d6d) and fight against this political witch hunt.

**Jeff wanted me to share this message with you. I hope you’ll read it.**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c4b7119e55&e=17913c7d6d)
---
Jeff in Fulton County, GA
| _Patriots,_

_For my entire career, I have fought for the preservation of what portions of the classic Constitution still remain. Fought against the erosion of the Constitution beginning in the Progressive Era, accelerating in the New Deal, and becoming normalized in the Post-Watergate Era. Against this tide, I have fought to restore the classical Constitution our Framers gave us, as wisely improved by the Reconstruction Amendments. And I’m not going to stop that fight now, whatever inversion, whatever destruction, and whatever anti-conservatives forces come at me — or whatever such forces come at_[ __](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=9760ed2710&e=17913c7d6d)_Donald Trump — or whatever schemes come at my other fellow co-defendants who will stand in solidarity as defenders of the Republic’s shards. I will use my intellect, my world-class education from pre-woke-destroyed institutions, my energy, and — most importantly — my prayer to help defend all 19 defendants against this onslaught. Count on it, Ms Willis and her collaborators. Count on it._ _Sincerely,_
_Jeffrey Clark_
---
| A gift right now of [$50, $100, or $250](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1d128d80d6&e=17913c7d6d) will go miles to help us continue to fight for Jeff and the rule of law.

Thank you for standing by Jeff and the Center.
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Center for Renewing America

subject: I’m running for Senate
body:
The stakes just went up.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T551be77a-34b3-4cd7-9d45-24cbcc1b2b82/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T66e7b18b-d6d6-4f01-8755-c85baf0e7efa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator. Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win. But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you. [I've set an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it. Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfe34f3cb-4d06-4a2b-9c1a-b6dd3ee24564/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | [DONATE NOW!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9615fe62-43da-4328-9ef4-205c22e11336/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet. Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage. My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life. Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on. That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, Peter, we can take him down. [So please, I’m personally asking: Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td4799cf5-9109-47b5-9519-7071d63b5af6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. # My Experience Being Targeted and Kicked Out of Congressman Robert Garcia’s Town Hall by His Staff
---
| | |
---
| | A week ago I attended a town hall hosted by Congressman Robert Garcia in Downtown Long Beach. I had properly RSVP'd and was initially granted entry by the event staff. However, something troubling happened that I believe speaks volumes about the Congressman and his staff. Shortly after I entered the event, I was unexpectedly escorted out by security personnel. To my surprise, I was told that I had not RSVP'd for the event, which was completely untrue. I had received two confirmations prior to attending, and it was disappointing to see that the staff had turned around and used this as an excuse to deny me access.
---
| |
---
| | For three hours, Congressman Garcia’s staff lied to me and about me. They even went so far as to accuse me of creating a fake confirmation RSVP text message - which is beyond delusional.
Not only that, but they also lied about the room being "at capacity". I don't know about you but I see plenty of empty seats in the photo captured by an attendee below.
---
| |
---
| | So based on all these lies, we can only assume that Congressman Garcia’s staff figured out I was his challenger and decided to kick me out for it. [READ ABOUT MY EXPERIENCE AS WRITTEN IN THE LONG BEACH POST HERE](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/82OekoDa6/c?w=fN6JUt91RGDKpipHPNvd2ajTWAxTr36tapHrY5qzSHE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sYnBvc3QuY29tL25ld3NsZXR0ZXIvdGhlLWhvdHRlc3QtdGlja2V0LWluLXRvd24vIiwiciI6ImQ5OGQwZjU0LWZjMGEtNGY1NS05YzYyLTk5NDAxZGVjYWFmZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjRhZWQ3NDRlLWRjM2EtNGUwYi1hYWY1LTZhZmMxNzc0ZGZlMyJ9)
All I wanted was the opportunity to ask Congressman Garcia a simple question: Why hasn't he shown up for the striking hotel workers in our district, particularly at Hotel Maya in Long Beach, where he has held campaign events?
The people of our district deserve a representative who not only listens but takes action when it matters most. It is disheartening to witness how those in power can attempt to suppress voices that challenge the status quo. My experience underscores the urgency of bringing fresh perspectives and new ideas to our district.
I firmly believe that together, we can create the change our community needs. I am committed to standing up against intimidation, advocating for transparency, and fighting for the issues that impact us all. But I cannot do this alone. Your support is crucial in ensuring that our voices are heard, our concerns addressed, and our representation improved. If you share my vision for a more accountable and inclusive leadership, I kindly ask for your support. [Consider making a donation of $10 today and help us secure a community space for a town hall that is actually open to the public and encourages everyone to express their concerns, regardless of whether they are challengers or not.](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/82OekoDa6/c?w=uW27glN4JsRc5z_ZTrfIUw1-8d8Bqk27k1Vp4ANPLWs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3ZvdGVmb3Jsb3BleiIsInIiOiJkOThkMGY1NC1mYzBhLTRmNTUtOWM2Mi05OTQwMWRlY2FhZmYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0YWVkNzQ0ZS1kYzNhLTRlMGItYWFmNS02YWZjMTc3NGRmZTMifQ)

| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z80u2bfb9gbd3gr113imcm2hg2bk55khdqd5cik8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj61pj6clh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu9gojr80l7r7nvfsh8vhbdk8s8q8ove6e9q3sl0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj61pj6clh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuu22aqgkdunicfgcbivv3bu5vld4nu8q4e56mq0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj61pj6clh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z190jbt7paihdbhsmeujrjp6s4a1sgn1c9ois2og_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpj61pj6clh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**

_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

Friends --
Can we tell you a quick story about Rule #1 for Elissa Slotkin in her political campaigns?
Here it goes: When Elissa first decided to run for public office, she had never been to a political fundraiser. Ever.
Hard to believe for a current member of Congress, but as a former national security person, she had never attended a political event.
But what Elissa knew when she got started is that one of the reasons so many Americans have lost trust in government is the role money plays in the political process.
**That's how Rule #1 was born: Elissa does not accept corporate PAC money.** She never wanted her constituents to question why she was voting a certain way, or have any doubt that she was fighting for their interests.
For many in Washington, this is seen as a disadvantage – especially since Senate campaigns are notoriously expensive.
But for Elissa, this is a matter of protecting our democracy. When you take a donation from a for-profit company, it makes average citizens question who you are voting on behalf of.
**But this means we are counting on lots and lots of people to contribute what they can, when they can, to power this campaign. Grassroots donations, as we’ve seen so clearly over the last few years, can exceed the tens of thousands we’d otherwise get from for-profit companies.**
Now, you may not have woken up this morning thinking that this was the day you were going to donate to help Elissa Slotkin keep Michigan blue in 2024, but that is what we are asking you to do.

I need your help to meet my end-of-month goal
| | Friend, This is MTG. I'm facing one of the most critical end-of-month deadlines of the year and we're still short of our $25,000 goal.
In the past year, Democrats have tried to strip my name off the ballot. . .
Democrat attorneys bankrolled by high-dollar left-wing donors even dragged me to court, forced me to "testify" hoping to throw me in jail. . .
**And although my name stayed on the ballot and I won in court, the Democrats succeeded in depleting my campaign defense funds after I had over a MILLION dollars in legal fees.**_** **_

_**Their attacks will NEVER stop.**_

Unfortunately for them, I will always work harder and I won't stop until we DEFEAT THE DEMOCRATS because I have the support of YOU - THE PEOPLE.
But I won't lie to you -having to defend against the onslaught of vicious attacks and nasty smears has been costly.
And that's exactly why the Democrats do it.
You see, this is the game they play:
They pick a target they need to silence.
They then throw everything they have to tarnish their name with media attack dogs and nasty articles. **They even deploy mobs of angry activists to our homes and harass us in public.**
And they use dark money donors like George Soros to bankroll radical DAs and other trial lawyers to target people like myself and President Trump.
One of their biggest tactics is to weaponize the legal system and force us to spend MILLIONS of dollars in campaign funds to defend ourselves so we can keep fighting to save this country.

Your donation gives me the ability to KEEP FIGHTING. It gives my campaign the resources to hire staff, make videos, and travel the country to spread the message of AMERICA FIRST.
_**And right now, I 'm worried my campaign won't reach our $25,000 end-of-month goal. **_
I know times are tough. So I'm only asking if you can absolutely afford to chip in at this time.
[**If $15 or more is too much, even a gift of $10 or just $5 goes a long way**](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=9dfe581dbc9c47ad83c91ed79c8cc713&_e=NGh3Yb_XCvZNgk7yfHuPsGMTgLKMAWyNqpKPR-tRmubLHbRUU2NWwpVD8x9nmD2sFsgijcu6bSwHeUpBgOEZkmYmu_5Q0OlF1msjRM4SdnO4HQijng--IRyCvKVgJzvCfgP2GwGvTQmFzeJKguJwp5YWUiOPKC6uaQX_RuoOOiXNqJ8Scmh0LrsKoNqhKnGy4oiCmOcifm9pJSOI-Pz9rt960geVNsrfYLuKp_UbYcVMp6HxjNNhuI49b4ugx4IX9MaI4o_b901R_9KPi7O8ata-A1RIi40ZghUvENT2LpSm8F-DE0nTgckyMAVN4zCMkRFDkmbchRFPS4J21hHCyQ%3D%3D).

Endorses John Duarte for Congress **
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

---
CONTACT: [Duane Dichiara](mailto:ddichiara@axiomstrategies.com?subject=%5BDuarte%5D)
(916) 997-4784
---
| | **(Modesto, CA)** — Today, Madera County District Attorney Sally Moreno endorsed John Duarte (R-13) in his re-election bid to California’s 13th Congressional District. Before being elected Madera District Attorney in 2018, Sally Moreno served as a prosecutor and Deputy DA.

John Duarte released the following statement regarding the endorsement.

“District Attorney Sally Moreno is a public safety champion,” said John Duarte. “She is an Army veteran, former peace officer, and former homicide prosecutor. Sally Moreno has committed her career to serving on the front lines, protecting victims, and safeguarding our community. I am thankful she has endorsed our campaign to Congress, and I look forward to continuing to work with her to protect the safety of Central Valley families.”

John is committed to ensuring the safety of Central Valley neighborhoods and protecting victims’ rights. District Attorney Sally Moreno joins a growing list of elected officials and public safety partners endorsing Duarte’s 2024 re-election campaign.

body:
If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...

| |

| | |

| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a4e2b3ecbd043579de70fe2d2fed1c2&_e=yCtlrLxR9MvcGUTX1nl6b6W4HeGqx7qomQ9jP4VlzM8TaJ_GAIZCordR8c4lD4cQIx62MEr-5S9tiKJkb1ca008sQk0-VcaWqH6mPUWJvR8XkYbX0LUO_oB4gB6fFwoMR4VbojUAu012Y20miVudOdb5D5WM__Cmsga1bxRS6T2nlayJfxCjD8eq-IuUU-36QGlbRQvD08OvshqwtMbnAaO56XvchdU91qZs-Mwy4j12Ec05UDjgFizRuiFUYMiNi9dFBUzHTh6w_q_iCufGb-lGVqMDaKbSOfnVBIaz9X-N-p6Q-sTt1s2Iz5HvkVxkjSu4f_Xn2M3uH4AecHpnOIfrqdGvxcestfdcmsHcsoYM0KOEzCasSZScL14MBErd "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a4e2b3ecbd043579de70fe2d2fed1c2&_e=yCtlrLxR9MvcGUTX1nl6b6W4HeGqx7qomQ9jP4VlzM8TaJ_GAIZCordR8c4lD4cQIx62MEr-5S9tiKJkb1ca008sQk0-VcaWqH6mPUWJvR8XkYbX0LUO_oB4gB6fFwoMR4VbojUAu012Y20miVudOdb5D5WM__Cmsga1bxRS6T2nlayJfxCjD8eq-IuUU-36QGlbRQvD08OvshqwtMbnAaO56XvchdU91qZs-Mwy4j3AkFmQEl_Ab33mp1djvpcQyakh8f6K--9V8Vs529ajpLjMH0aPAaIL2kDGzHJN374nMeCYIOsoOihlGnKX-RgbPs885QFkv_mmImuN8bEXZ4ymWyqTDpxGazi0PpH-MhbsErmqHs-C-KPnePnlXhOR "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today. ")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a4e2b3ecbd043579de70fe2d2fed1c2&_e=yCtlrLxR9MvcGUTX1nl6b6W4HeGqx7qomQ9jP4VlzM8TaJ_GAIZCordR8c4lD4cQIx62MEr-5S9tiKJkb1ca008sQk0-VcaWqH6mPUWJvR8XkYbX0LUO_oB4gB6fFwoMR4VbojUAu012Y20miVudOdb5D5WM__Cmsga1bxRS6T2nlayJfxCjD8eq-IuUU-36QGlbRQvD08OvshqwtMbnAaO56XvchdU91qZs-Mwy4j1aLM245SLwnFQpTengs7AxkveR4uLyHXdCWXjSGPy7Qb7AaiskF0SFHUF2CVpiA8dCYP6MDUX92-10NO0JQ4gLmOdmBFKSt1m8P170Q2Dkj9bZlMQXOvqZiHETw_3iz9aDri2QtYJQ7iQSI9XYGbxn "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0a4e2b3ecbd043579de70fe2d2fed1c2&_e=yCtlrLxR9MvcGUTX1nl6b6W4HeGqx7qomQ9jP4VlzM8TaJ_GAIZCordR8c4lD4cQIx62MEr-5S9tiKJkb1ca008sQk0-VcaWqH6mPUWJvR8XkYbX0LUO_oB4gB6fFwoMR4VbojUAu012Y20miVudOdb5D5WM__Cmsga1bxRS6T2nlayJfxCjD8eq-IuUU-36QGlbRQvD08OvshqwtMbnAaO56XvchdU91qZs-Mwy4j1QfextWX3hKBAjRLtCuKz0UoLCknBqvPEEkNe_8Vg1DvUNbEWMpApTY2bGiVFty-jHxzGR1jR2tyyIxneMW-LIWnXlfcVAwu9BqbhcJJG9zk-xUBxmUWYseoOFYIAxhpcVPQnnfm7RixkIL4PCF5q2 "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country. ")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

# [Don't let Trump move his Georgia trial out of Georgia to escape justice](https://default.salsalabs.org/T73d91c1b-8fb8-4cec-a168-ba270ae38758/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Now that DA Fani Willis has built a solid case against Trump and his co-conspirators, this merry band of criminals is trying desperately to get the case moved out of Georgia and into a federal court. Why? **So that they can get a more "Trump-friendly" judge and jury, and possibly delay it past the election, allowing Trump to escape justice completely.** Former Chief of Staff Mark Meadows is even making the absurd case that pressuring Georgia officials to overturn the 2020 election was part of his official duties, and thus, under federal jurisdiction. It's ridiculous and dangerous at the same time. **The charges are for Georgia state crimes, and the trial should be in Georgia courts.** Plus, Trump as president would no doubt try to pardon himself if convicted in a federal court. (This is a legally dubious area, since these could still be state charges, even if tried in federal court, but let's not give Trump the chance to test it) [**Don't let Trump escape justice. Add your name, and tell the officials who'll be making this decision NOT to let Trump move his trial out of Georgia courts.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2eb77e45-11dd-47f0-9e5a-270f707ecbd2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Sean Themea
subject: A New Declaration of Independence
body:
We must fight to protect the truths we hold to be self-evident...

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd0o59p6k95gpl5v8lfefl3q4jqg82i2rokb862g_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpgm4o76c9h2bs)

Friend,

When in the course of human events, it becomes necessary to stand up against tyranny in any of its forms, both on campus and in the legislature.

Anyone who has any respect for the ideas this country was founded upon must take action when the opponents of liberty abuse undermine the rights of American citizens.

**We must fight to protect the truths we hold to be self-evident, that all men are created equal and that they are endowed by their Creator with certain unalienable rights;_Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness_.**

Young Americans for Liberty is continuing the fight to protect those unalienable rights. I am Sean Themea, Chief Operating Officer of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL).

YAL is the nation's largest, most active, and most effective youth liberty organization on campus and in American electoral politics.

[You can support the thousands of students who have joined the fight for liberty. Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today by clicking here >>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zotl61u69r1dmi5ugj0j3s70o404962shr8ndei0_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpgm4o76c9h2bs)

The purpose of government is to secure these rights, nothing more.

But when that government becomes destructive against the rights it's supposed to secure, it is the right of the people to stand up against tyrannical policies and organize to create change.

We've seen the long train of abuses the radical socialists have leveled on conservative activists. It's practically absolute despotism! The history of the U.S. government is a history of repeated injuries and establishing an absolute tyranny over the rights of the individual.

**Young Americans for Liberty is preparing to stand up against the ongoing tyranny of the socialists on college campuses and in the legislature by training the next generation of freedom fighters. **

_YAL helps students engage with politics and policies_ on a deeper level with our in-depth programming and outreach. We work diligently to bring a meaningful pro-liberty message through student-led events and activities.
[You can support the thousands of students who have joined the fight for liberty. Please consider donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today by clicking here >>_>_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zh4o9sbm5c23p808ks6hce0usf8b6tcke54varcg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpgm4o76c9h2bs)

Let's take a look a some of the more recent attacks on our rights:
* Empowering the IRS to send swarms of tax agents to harass our people and eat out our substance.
* Getting involved in foreign wars without the consent of our legislatures, even in times of peace.
* Using tariffs to cut off trade with parts of the world.
* Increasing taxes on us.
* Labeling concerned mothers as domestic terrorists and using the FBI to spy on them.
* Locking down American citizens while declaring themselves invested with emergency powers.
Worked with Big Tech companies to censor our Free Speech.

**But YAL activists have the power to radically shift the direction of our country.**

Your generous support will set up YAL for another successful year of helping students get informed and take up the fight for liberty!

[You can help YAL provide student activists with the resources they need to lead the fight for liberty on campus and in our cities. Please consider donating $100, $50, $35, or even just $10 by clicking here today >>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfhvi2t4ppi85scsaid1uefqg21t2fr3v44mpli8_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpgm4o76c9h2bs)

Whenever YAL activists encounter tyrannical policies, they take action to change these policies.

Oftentimes, they encounter difficulties from administrators, legislatures, or anyone else who benefits from the status quo.

**But policies that promote tyranny are unfit to exist in a free society.**

It's why YAL trains thousands of pro-liberty student activists and candidates on how to message the ideas of liberty and how to use the best techniques to win campaigns.

**YAL has won over 100 free speech victories** and has built a coalition
of liberty legislators across the country to limit the size and scope of
government.

The Founding Fathers pledged their lives, fortunes, and sacred honor to fight against tyranny. Will you donate today to help YAL do the same?

**Your generous donation supports YAL 's efforts to Make Liberty WIN!**
[Donate $10](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zht4t4bl63g6n1mj33bb3ss9htvpbcgohhh5lheg_rp22sh2s8i66p76cpgm4o76c9h2bs)

name: Marsha Blackburn
subject: I will never take this seat for granted
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
The 2020 Democrat Senate nominee recently announced that she’s running again. This time, it will be against me. | Fellow American,

**IT’S OFFICIAL:**_The 2020 Democrat Senate nominee in Tennessee is once again running for federal office: this time against me._
She’s a Memphis **ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE ADVOCATE (!!!)** who lost to Senator Bill Hagerty in 2020 and thinks that this time around she’ll have better luck.

I know it’s important to take every race and every challenger **_SERIOUSLY._** There is no telling what the national political landscape will be this time next year!

My first five years in the Senate have **_FLOWN BY_** and still, it feels like we’re JUST GETTING STARTED -- there is still so much work to be done in the SENATE. Hard-working Tennesseans need someone who will go to work and fight on their behalf every day, just like you do. clean_body: | | | | Senators make some of the most important decisions in our government. Senators are vital to the budget and appropriations process, get the final say on more than 1,200 executive branch nominations, and confirm every federal judge. I'm happy to say that most of my colleagues use that decision-making authority responsibly. Unfortunately, some others just cause mayhem. If you are looking for an example of mayhem, look no farther than Senator Mitch McConnell. You may remember him as the man who made up a rule so he could steal a Supreme Court nomination in 2016, and then forgot about that rule long enough to steal another nomination in 2020. And if Senate Republicans win back the majority, they'll put McConnell in charge again so he can cheat his way to more prizes for his extremist base. So we need 100 people to join our grassroots movement before midnight on August 31 so we can start organizing the grassroots to stop McConnell. = = How do we know McConnell can't be trusted to do what is right for working families? Just look at his track record: Opposed campaign finance reform; Sued the FEC to say money is speech; Opposed the Affordable Care Act; Called for deep cuts to Medicaid and Medicare; Nearly caused a government default in 2011; Blocked gun-control legislation; Blocked minimum wage increases; Overused and abused the filibuster by his party Refused a vote for the SCOTUS nomination of Merrick Garland; Supported Donald Trump in the 2016 election; Forced through the Nomination of ultra-conservative Supreme Court Justice Neil Gorsuch; Forced through the nomination of Brett Kavanaugh; Forced through the SCOTUS nomination of Amy Coney Barrett less than two months before the 2020 election; Pushed through the disastrous Trump tax cuts in 2017; Coordinated with the Trump White House during the first Trump impeachment; Refused to acknowledge Joe Biden's presidential win until December, 2020; Voted to acquit Trump in the second Impeachment trial; and Pledged to vote for Trump again in 2024 if he got the chance. This is just a fraction of the havoc he has wreaked since he was elected to the U.S. Senate in 1984. And if he takes back the leader's gavel, the list will only get longer. We need to stand together and stop the GOP extremists from taking over the Senate and putting McConnell back in charge. = Onward! [**Can you chip in just $3 today to help us invest in year-round, on-the-ground organizing and bench-building in neglected communities across the country?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68857328/424364324/1988962032?refcode=2023-08-29-cer-ed-intro&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=afe47e67-9046-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTVAvMS85MjA2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZmU0N2U2Ny05MDQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U0PIapvTgA1UNZulXSaRc7phcg36nFU08qFXEBAIYSU=)

So, what's the strategy?
**A Targeted Approach:** Identify which local offices are on the ballot, how to file, when to file, and all the important info a prospective candidate needs to know.
**Recruit Candidates:** Work with the national, state, and local Democratic parties to reach out to their members and communities of interest and encourage them to run. We invite prospective candidates to meet local party leaders, connect them with coaches and training resources, and help them file for office.
**Long-term Organizing:** Provide local organizers and county parties with unlimited volunteer recruitment, training, and small grants for completing organizing goals. Continually invest in long-term rural organizing capacity.
**This strategy works. Since 2018, we've moved the needle!**

Can I tell you something, Fellow American?

**My district leans Republican.**

_We were represented by Republicans for twenty years._

But then Democrats pulled a fast one. They redrew our district lines in the middle of the cycle, using the courts to gerrymander Pennsylvania before the “Blue Wave” election in 2018.

The result? We’re now represented by a radical progressive named Susan Wild.

Where does that leave us?

**_The experts say this is the most competitive district in the most competitive state in America – the one most likely to decide the Presidency in 2024._**

[**It is time for change. As a ninth-generation resident of the Greater Lehigh Valley, I’m the man for the job... and I have the record to prove it.**](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=cedf26bdbb9d4803bb5b4f034d008067&_e=4SaGjP68TwL4jv2pzAqcNZyvugb9PjRnpRdgTlwkvyaDoNR9pJ2ghwXSeR0AJIJicr-VhS6tTDFXjTQ1AobgOOCYJzLONWxrPVgbC7e7tAA89e6OF4_2_0bi6g1XNielN-QQC1YMymTCb1smSc449iIH_R2nMhF1yDHD27-QxtBjAgst2hgPblM_5SFWypxbP1o5g5pYBoJRWboT98bTd0TZ3enD24koysKAyX3zWR9_WyC7QFNul7CoqUAcCep44GxH6iBM903tKOhM9ku7sg6t4M4nGLgc6WD4eOoy4o3tNX1wLS6wU0IC90o8jqCEco1fLXtelDR05uxx2MkfhFACjLv9cIAE-Ed6ljit-ISpqenkhPZTmnoosyl0WOofIXQDz3Y4wt5PvKjUZ8rDpA%3D%3D)

I’ve worked for the people of Pennsylvania for years as a State Representative, and I’ve _consistently_ delivered results. I’ve _always_ put America First. Here are just a few ways:

* Never voted for a tax increase.
* Voted for curriculum transparency in K-12 schools and to expand school choice options for parents, so parents know what is being taught to their children.
* Co-prime sponsor of legislation to stop sanctuary cities in Pennsylvania.
* Consistent voting record of protecting 2nd Amendment rights.
* Voted for Voter ID and other election integrity efforts that would make it easier to vote and harder to cheat.

But if Biden can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

It's not just about cotton candy and rides – it's an opportunity to refresh your voter registration and play your part in shaping our democracy. Remember, a new Minnesota law has opened doors for 16- and 17-year-olds to pre-register to vote. This means that even before they turn 18, they can set the stage for participating in our democratic process. Let's empower our young people to make their voices heard. Don't miss this chance to ensure your voter registration is up-to-date and encourage young adults to take that crucial first step toward civic engagement - especially as we approach a presidential election in 2024. Your participation matters, and together, we can strengthen the foundation of our democracy. See you at the fair! Steve Simon | | = ********** ******** | = | = With Steve’s leadership, Minnesota has led the nation in voter turnout for the past three out of four elections. His top priorities are defending our democracy, strengthening the freedom to vote for all eligible Minnesotans, pushing back against dangerous disinformation about our elections, providing support for small businesses, and enhancing security protections for our most vulnerable. = ** Prepared and paid for by Simon for Secretary of State Committee Simon for Secretary of State Committee P.O. | | Here’s the plan to defeat Donald Trump:

**_Win in Georgia in 2024._**

Friend, I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68871949/424380176/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4402-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTMxZmJiZS05YTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ApWnYEbGCF5iJFUDjy_iW3o3fCso7uzaEMU-XGgzyQk=)
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.
We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.
My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**

body:
The 2020 Democrat Senate nominee recently announced that she’s running again. This time, it will be against me. | Fellow American,

**IT’S OFFICIAL:**_The 2020 Democrat Senate nominee in Tennessee is once again running for federal office: this time against me._
She’s a Memphis **ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE ADVOCATE (!!!)** who lost to Senator Bill Hagerty in 2020 and thinks that this time around she’ll have better luck.

I know it’s important to take every race and every challenger **_SERIOUSLY._** There is no telling what the national political landscape will be this time next year!

## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=235eb04c6aef4fd498de9b7750c45aa4&_e=FdwrFLFsOI6UnEE4qA2Udb3mWoVag01-VGLH3maoAGfZ6tpBYiitl9u03nZz3UWc02jdabrrjViHQUoFud85dOIGJe3LsztLwMpX7xad1PDxnFAPJ9NIqVLA24sC7ge7_CH18eF0E0UMY6SOS23jVs_2QLLTOVPOQB5vEzkqP2DxOGHefOTTh8vayQxVJmCrHMJUWEsfuVEF9Ze8ygZUYQpiLOtG_zj7J-T0ay3jR-Eylaq1wq3QjOCQgeo87iXtOMKySDsppx5Zn0qSGmQmXpuQvax3lWkoKP2ym1NH9BD8YUq6U5YM15vvC5cN7oV5Ys5Swm-ju1BMdO7JkH-NrdqEUMTXkFJYjsUSYrLcpWvf8BL5ypSeacd9j1vddDVj_maOLW3NKS9UGj_LGFwsG_319My2uBnpjti-7wyEIF4%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=235eb04c6aef4fd498de9b7750c45aa4&_e=FdwrFLFsOI6UnEE4qA2Udb3mWoVag01-VGLH3maoAGfZ6tpBYiitl9u03nZz3UWc02jdabrrjViHQUoFud85dOIGJe3LsztLwMpX7xad1PDxnFAPJ9NIqVLA24sC7ge7_CH18eF0E0UMY6SOS23jVs_2QLLTOVPOQB5vEzkqP2DxOGHefOTTh8vayQxVJmCrHMJUWEsfuVEF9Ze8ygZUYQpiLOtG_zj7J-T0ay3jR-Eylaq1wq3QjOCQgeo87iXtOMKySDsppx5Zn0qSGmQmXiIqMCHGB9agw2oPgp4hqAx6L4KMMzoPNokjpCV_AyGeGOSyKrNMKQSADaN9vGVC9HMJlGdHHbq0DHFH4bS6XYrhPqoiysZSLTbpQ-QtJj5j-Yp3OKr77u-hDms-bKCnuJUSA6wTPcdWTd4tAXfmm6Y%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=235eb04c6aef4fd498de9b7750c45aa4&_e=FdwrFLFsOI6UnEE4qA2Udb3mWoVag01-VGLH3maoAGfZ6tpBYiitl9u03nZz3UWc02jdabrrjViHQUoFud85dOIGJe3LsztLwMpX7xad1PDxnFAPJ9NIqVLA24sC7ge7_CH18eF0E0UMY6SOS23jVs_2QLLTOVPOQB5vEzkqP2DxOGHefOTTh8vayQxVJmCrHMJUWEsfuVEF9Ze8ygZUYQpiLOtG_zj7J-T0ay3jR-Eylaq1wq3QjOCQgeo87iXtOMKySDsppx5Zn0qSGmQmXuUUqrOin_09sOrXi7P6vCgoJStTcvDjbgbAukcj2MlaIbth-PFcKBhf4C34odS1Nc61hWxYLrGEH0ZaaU1f8GF5QG_EE0kwWTzr4QoIg0WdfDxzYPsyVCHD87OuaMdPOKdmwpTTEdrft5oFY_vLx7Q%3D)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

body:
There’s no reason it should cost an arm and a leg to file your taxes. It should be fast and free. | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68885473/424417079/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ16E_TAX_E_20230829_V1S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzkzZTUwNy1jMDQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kINmSXYjx2PGSxe5YU0cby9BV0TccP6ulNJY5QIbeE=&emci=4b93e507-c046-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=4c93e507-c046-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9027908)
---
They're at it again. For decades, big tax prep companies — like H&R Block and TurboTax — have lobbied the government with one main goal: making the tax-filing process as time-consuming and wallet-emptying as possible for you. They’ve padded their profits by cornering consumers into using their products, even using deceptive practices and outright lies to hide the free options they’re supposed to offer. So I called them out. We fought back. And last year, we won a big victory, securing funding the IRS can use to stand up its own free filing service. But the tax prep giants sprang into action as soon as the IRS announced a pilot program. They hired fancy lobbyists. They launched a slick campaign. They’re trying to stop this reform in its tracks. Once again, they’re taking the money they’ve made by ripping off taxpayers — and using it to lobby for the ability to rip off even more taxpayers. So once again, I’m calling them out — and side by side, we’ll fight back and beat them. Congresswoman Katie Porter and I just wrote a letter to the big tax prep companies. We’re asking them to account for how much they’ve spent on lobbying against free tax filing, how much they’d stand to lose if this reform takes effect, and what kinds of contact they’ve had with government officials. We’re working to uncover what they’re doing (and spending) behind the scenes. And we’ll keep fighting to stop them from sabotaging free tax filing. I also just released a report on how the tax prep industry enabled Meta to harvest millions of taxpayers’ sensitive personal and financial data to use for advertising purposes. I’m calling on agencies to investigate and to prosecute any violations of the law. I’m going to stay on this. I’ll keep working to hold off the lobbyists and keep them from blocking this reform. Because there’s no reason it should cost an arm and a leg to file your taxes. It should be fast and free. And, these companies should not be able to violate the privacy of taxpayers. This is part of how we make our government work for working people, not just giant corporations that can hire armies of lobbyists. We’ve seen that when we fight, we win. We beat Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices for seniors. We beat billionaire corporations to make sure they’d pay federal income taxes on their massive profits. And we’ll beat the tax prep lobby to make it fast and free to file your taxes. [**I’m able to stay in this fight because of your support. So if it makes sense for you right now, I’m asking you to pitch in $20 or any amount to our re-election campaign. Every contribution adds to help hit our important August fundraising goal. clean_body: There’s no reason it should cost an arm and a leg to file your taxes. It should be fast and free. | | | They're at it again. For decades, big tax prep companies — like H&R Block and TurboTax — have lobbied the government with one main goal: making the tax-filing process as time-consuming and wallet-emptying as possible for you. They’ve padded their profits by cornering consumers into using their products, even using deceptive practices and outright lies to hide the free options they’re supposed to offer. So I called them out. We fought back. And last year, we won a big victory, securing funding the IRS can use to stand up its own free filing service. But the tax prep giants sprang into action as soon as the IRS announced a pilot program. They hired fancy lobbyists. They launched a slick campaign. They’re trying to stop this reform in its tracks. Once again, they’re taking the money they’ve made by ripping off taxpayers — and using it to lobby for the ability to rip off even more taxpayers. So once again, I’m calling them out — and side by side, we’ll fight back and beat them. Congresswoman Katie Porter and I just wrote a letter to the big tax prep companies. We’re asking them to account for how much they’ve spent on lobbying against free tax filing, how much they’d stand to lose if this reform takes effect, and what kinds of contact they’ve had with government officials. We’re working to uncover what they’re doing (and spending) behind the scenes. And we’ll keep fighting to stop them from sabotaging free tax filing. I also just released a report on how the tax prep industry enabled Meta to harvest millions of taxpayers’ sensitive personal and financial data to use for advertising purposes. I’m calling on agencies to investigate and to prosecute any violations of the law. I’m going to stay on this. I’ll keep working to hold off the lobbyists and keep them from blocking this reform. Because there’s no reason it should cost an arm and a leg to file your taxes. It should be fast and free. And, these companies should not be able to violate the privacy of taxpayers. This is part of how we make our government work for working people, not just giant corporations that can hire armies of lobbyists. We’ve seen that when we fight, we win. We beat Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices for seniors. We beat billionaire corporations to make sure they’d pay federal income taxes on their massive profits. And we’ll beat the tax prep lobby to make it fast and free to file your taxes. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate All content © 2023 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

First, I wanted to thank everyone who took the time to come to my town hall with Rep. Yadira Caraveo last week, along with everyone who filled out my campaign’s Town Hall Issue Survey [https://secure.michaelbennet.com/a/caraveo-town-hall-survey-1] .
Hearing directly from Coloradans is a critical part of how I do my job. Hearing your thoughts, concerns, and questions — whether in person or online — makes a difference in how I take on the biggest issues facing our state.
These were some of the key topics we discussed on Monday night:
*
Supporting
our
veterans:
We
need
to
make
sure
veterans
have
access
to
the
care,
services,
and
benefits
they
need
to
thrive
during
and
after
their
service.
The
PACT
Act,
which
we
passed
one
year
ago,
expanded
health
coverage
to
3.5
million
toxic-exposed
veterans.
It
was
the
biggest
expansion
of
health
care
for
veterans
in
decades
—
but
we
can’t
stop
there.
*
Fixing
our
broken
immigration
system:
In
2013,
I
was
part
of
the
Gang
of
Eight
who
came
together
to
create
and
pass
comprehensive
immigration
reform
through
the
Senate.
It
was
an
incredible
moment
of
bipartisanship
—
until
the
bill
was
blocked
by
far-right
Republicans
in
the
House.
Reforming
our
broken
immigration
system
is
possible,
and
I
will
work
with
any
Senator
to
come
up
with
a
solution
that
honors
both
our
history
as
a
nation
of
immigrants
and
the
rule
of
law.
*
Bipartisanship:
Citizens
United,
gerrymandering,
and
the
elimination
of
key
parts
from
the
Voting
Rights
Act
of
1965
have
created
a
system
that
allows
Republicans
to
play
“shutdown
politics.”
They’d
rather
block
any
chance
of
progress
than
come
to
the
table
and
work
on
solutions.
This
can’t
continue.
We
must
reform
our
campaign
finance
laws,
protect
our
democracy,
and
get
back
to
making
progress
for
the
American
people
—
and
I’ll
work
with
anyone
in
Washington
to
get
it
done.
We make progress by staying focused on the issues that matter most — and by electing public officials who are committed to doing the best for their constituents.
I’m working hard to make sure we elect and re-elect progressive champions across the country. I don’t accept a dime from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists, which makes your grassroots support now even more important.
Will you chip in now to help protect our majority in the Senate and take back control of the House? Colorado deserves leadership who fights for them, not for special interests or shadowy super PACs. name: The Courier Newsroom Team
subject: Trump's running Facebook ads again (and it's not good)
body:
In the past week, Trump's campaign spent nearly $60,000 on Facebook ads to spread misinformation about his 91 criminal charges.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1476%2E120351%2ElWCB8d)
Peter,
Trump steaks. Trump University. For decades, Donald Trump and scams have fit together like a hand in a glove.
When he got into politics, Trump took his lifelong grift online, famously using Facebook ads to spread misinformation and lies about Hillary Clinton and other political rivals.
Trump was eventually kicked off of Facebook after January 6th, but Facebook recently reinstated his account. Predictably, Trump is at it again, this time using Facebook ads to smear prosecutors and spread lies that his 91 criminal charges are part of some liberal conspiracy:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230829?refcode=em20230829&amount=&refcode2=1476_120351_lWCB8d&akid=1476%2E120351%2ElWCB8d)
[**Peter, will you chip in any amount before our August deadline to help us fight back against Trump's lies? At COURIER, our innovative model delivers factual, local journalism directly to communities vulnerable to Trump's misinformation campaigns on Facebook.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230829?refcode=em20230829&amount=&refcode2=1476_120351_lWCB8d&akid=1476%2E120351%2ElWCB8d)
Trump is hyper-focused on playing the victim right now for a lot of reasons. First, he's terrified of going to prison. Second, his legal bills are mounting, and Facebook ads help him raise the money he needs to pay them.
**The most unfortunate and disturbing reason is that spreading the lie that he's the victim of a liberal conspiracy is good politics right now. Since his first indictment, Trump's support among Republican primary voters has skyrocketed.**
Peter, it's clear that Facebook isn't stepping up to stop Trump's lies, which means our work at COURIER to correct the record is more important than ever.
Right now, our team of talented journalists is laser-focused on correcting the record in online spaces like Facebook. With so much on the line for the rule of law and our democracy, they are combating misinformation in real time by providing communities with factual journalism they can trust.
But to keep our relevant, trustworthy journalism accessible for all, we must reach our monthly fundraising goals. [**Can you help power this vital work by making a $5 contribution today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230829?refcode=em20230829&amount=5&refcode2=1476_120351_lWCB8d&akid=1476%2E120351%2ElWCB8d)

body:
It really comes down to where my story began: |
#
Folks, this is Senator Jacky Rosen from Nevada. I recently launched my first reelection campaign for the U.S. Senate here in Nevada – and I couldn’t be more grateful for the outpouring of support from people like you. **As we ramp things up, I want to share a bit more about why I’m in this fight.** It really comes down to where my story began: in a working-class family, as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. At a young age, my loved ones instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I’ve carried them with me throughout my entire life. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68877042/424388409/-1273059122?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230829_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDRjN2E4Mi1hMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gov1a-QOjTXagZknTA30dEy6Mtp4ryaTXaskyUVAr9o=) These values drove me to become the first in my family to graduate from college – working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace and taking out student loans to cover the cost. They drove me while I worked as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field – seeing inequality in our workforce firsthand. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68877043/424388410/-1273059122?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230829_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDRjN2E4Mi1hMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gov1a-QOjTXagZknTA30dEy6Mtp4ryaTXaskyUVAr9o=) And they drove me during my first Senate race when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds to become only the second woman senator in Nevada's history. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68877044/424388411/-1273059122?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230829_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDRjN2E4Mi1hMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gov1a-QOjTXagZknTA30dEy6Mtp4ryaTXaskyUVAr9o=) To this day, my path is lit by these guiding lights. They fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans, no matter who you are or where you come from. **But right now,_The Washington Post_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection – and _FiveThirtyEight_ says that Nevada could once again decide Senate control. That’s why the GOP is coming after me as a TOP target for defeat.** I simply can’t fight back and defend my battleground seat without your critical grassroots support. **That’s why I have to ask:[Please, will you split $10 between my campaign and Tina Smith’s now – before our crucial end-of-month deadline – to become one of the essential Reelection Founding Donors we need to win in Nevada and defend the Senate for Democrats?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68877045/424388412/-1273059122?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&amount=10&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230829_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDRjN2E4Mi1hMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gov1a-QOjTXagZknTA30dEy6Mtp4ryaTXaskyUVAr9o=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Jacky Rosen and Tina Smith will go through immediately:_ | | [SPLIT $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68877046/424388413/-1273059122?express_lane=true&amount=10&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20230829_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDRjN2E4Mi1hMTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gov1a-QOjTXagZknTA30dEy6Mtp4ryaTXaskyUVAr9o=)

clean_body: It really comes down to where my story began: | Folks, this is Senator Jacky Rosen from Nevada. I recently launched my first reelection campaign for the U.S. Senate here in Nevada – and I couldn’t be more grateful for the outpouring of support from people like you. As we ramp things up, I want to share a bit more about why I’m in this fight. It really comes down to where my story began: in a working-class family, as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. At a young age, my loved ones instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I’ve carried them with me throughout my entire life. = These values drove me to become the first in my family to graduate from college – working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace and taking out student loans to cover the cost. They drove me while I worked as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field – seeing inequality in our workforce firsthand. = And they drove me during my first Senate race when I defeated a Republican incumbent against all odds to become only the second woman senator in Nevada's history. = To this day, my path is lit by these guiding lights. They fuel my fight to advocate for working families and bring much-needed progress to the lives of all Nevadans, no matter who you are or where you come from. But right now,The Washington Post is calling me one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection – and FiveThirtyEight says that Nevada could once again decide Senate control. That’s why the GOP is coming after me as a TOP target for defeat. I simply can’t fight back and defend my battleground seat without your critical grassroots support. | | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Have you ever known somebody who actually lived under tyranny? They always seem to cherish their freedom the most.

Mike Zimmer is one of those people.

At 17 years old, during the height of the Cold War, [Mike escaped from Bulgaria](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=eeebbc71d9&e=1090c5c412) by cutting through an electric fence and crawling across a minefield to Greece. He immigrated to the United States legally with $45 in his pocket and the dream of a better life. Today, he is the owner of the [Original Doughboy’s Pizza Restaurant](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=9fa3c30a89&e=1090c5c412) in Wind Gap, Northampton County, a popular and delicious landmark known throughout the Slate Belt.

I met Mike at Moore Township Community Days and talked with him at his restaurant. Like many of you, he’s concerned about lawlessness in our communities and thinks our leaders need to crackdown on crime. He also wants less red tape and fewer bureaucratic hurdles that make it hard to serve customers and create jobs. He said too many politicians have no idea what it takes to run a local business.

Mostly though, Mike loves his adopted country. He's grateful for the opportunities he’s received and for the religious freedom he enjoys. And he goes out of his way to thank the men and women of the U.S. Armed Forces.

Like many of you, Mike is concerned that we are losing our American way of life. But he’s also optimistic that hope and freedom will prevail. So am I.

Thank you, Mike, for sharing your story, and for inspiring others to live the American Dream.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

The school district I graduated from right in York, PA, passed what CNN called the largest book ban in the history of American public education in 2021. They banned over 300 books, _including the biographies of Rosa Parks and MLK._
Even Fox News ran a story calling the ban racially motivated and wrong -- and imagine how bad it’s got to be to be too extreme for Fox News. 🤯🤯
**So I’m helping fight back by supporting candidates for school board who are opposed to these radical bans.**

Every year, Matt (AKA Gunny) leads our family in planting and caring for our garden. The kids love it; the bunnies love it; the deer love it; I love it.
This summer, we're growing:
* Jalapeños
* Green beans
* Carrots
* Lettuce
* Cherry tomatoes
* Green onion
* Cucumbers
* Eggplant
* Squash

Back at campaign HQ, we like to talk about how we're going to win this election "one neighbor at a time."
**So, in the interest of really treating you like a neighbor, I've decided to share a summer garden recipe with you all.**
_The Barr Family's Quick Pickles:_
_Ingredients:_
2 quart-sized jars
3 or 4 large cucumbers cut up
4 cups of water
2 cups vinegar
2 tablespoons kosher salt
1 tsp sugar
Fresh dill (about 8 stalks) (remove thick stems)
1 head of garlic (remove skin and smash)
Peppercorns
_Directions:_
1. Make brine: bring the water, vinegar, salt and sugar to a boil.
2. Put cut up cucumbers in the two quart jars with dill (about three to four stalks per jar, or to taste), garlic (divided), peppercorns (about 10 per jar or quart).
3. Fill with brine (water, vinegar, salt, and sugar)
4. Put in the fridge for at least two weeks and then ENJOY!!

I hope you enjoy making it as much as I do – and best of luck with your summer harvest!
Best,
Callie
Candidate for Congress in Michigan's 1st District

clean_body: It's time to reap the rewards of our summer garden! | = Dear Peter, it's time to reap the rewards of our summer garden! | = Every year, Matt (AKA Gunny) leads our family in planting and caring for our garden. The kids love it; the bunnies love it; the deer love it; I love it. This summer, we're growing: Jalapeños Green beans Carrots Lettuce Cherry tomatoes Green onion Cucumbers Eggplant Squash Back at campaign HQ, we like to talk about how we're going to win this election "one neighbor at a time." So, in the interest of really treating you like a neighbor, I've decided to share a summer garden recipe with you all. The Barr Family's Quick Pickles: Ingredients: 2 quart-sized jars 3 or 4 large cucumbers cut up 4 cups of water 2 cups vinegar 2 tablespoons kosher salt 1 tsp sugar Fresh dill (about 8 stalks) (remove thick stems) 1 head of garlic (remove skin and smash) Peppercorns Directions: 1. Make brine: bring the water, vinegar, salt and sugar to a boil. 2. Put cut up cucumbers in the two quart jars with dill (about three to four stalks per jar, or to taste), garlic (divided), peppercorns (about 10 per jar or quart). 3. Fill with brine (water, vinegar, salt, and sugar) 4. Put in the fridge for at least two weeks and then ENJOY!! I hope you enjoy making it as much as I do – and best of luck with your summer harvest! Best, Callie Candidate for Congress in Michigan's 1st District P.S.
