Peter Willis, big news!

Our Revolution is endorsing Jovanka Beckles for State Senate in California’s District 7 — and we are very excited about this race!

We hope that you will help build a winning grassroots team (https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/Jovanka_Beckles_ptv_copy/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230829_PT_nlrb_0_3MO_larrycohen_na_na_confirmGwynneWilcox&t=1008&akid=4602%2E5885482%2ErvITSB) to help her win the March 2024 primary and the general election next November.

https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/Jovanka_Beckles_ptv_copy/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230829_PT_nlrb_0_3MO_larrycohen_na_na_confirmGwynneWilcox&t=1009&akid=4602%2E5885482%2ErvITSB

Our Revolution endorsed Jovanka in her successful campaigns for Richmond City Council, and she’s been twice backed by Bernie Sanders - including in 2014 when she took on Chevron for polluting her community and WON!

As a city counselor, she was able to increase the minimum wage, introduce and pass Ban the Box, support local labor unions, advocate for and pass rent control, hold corporate polluters accountable, and make Richmond a sanctuary city.

“These were progressive policies that I continued to push for even after being told they would be impossible to do on the local level,” Jovanka said on a recent Our Revolution call.

Will you join the Our Revolution for Jovanka Beckles Organizing team? (https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/Jovanka_Beckles_ptv_copy/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230829_PT_nlrb_0_3MO_larrycohen_na_na_confirmGwynneWilcox&t=1010&akid=4602%2E5885482%2ErvITSB)

JOIN THE TEAM » (https://act.ourrevolution.com/signup/Jovanka_Beckles_ptv_copy/?source=EM_NBI_OR_20230829_PT_nlrb_0_3MO_larrycohen_na_na_confirmGwynneWilcox&t=1011&akid=4602%2E5885482%2ErvITSB)

Our Revolution also endorsed Jovanka for the Alameda-Contra Costa Transit District Board of Directors. She ensured that transit workers received hazard pay during the pandemic and she has continued her support of pro-worker and pro-labor union policies by working closely with the labor movement. As a member herself of Teamsters Local 856, Jovanka can be found on picket lines at a moment’s notice.

Jovanka would be the first black candidate to represent this district in nearly 40 years. She brings lived experience as a Black, Queer, immigrant, Latinx woman and a voice that is needed in state government.

“I am the only Black female candidate who is vying for a seat at the table,” she said. There are currently only two Black Americans out of 40 representatives for the whole state.

“I’m running because we need bold leadership willing to take action for what is right—who will be courageous on climate, healthcare, criminal justice reform, housing, taxing the rich, women’s and worker’s rights, and more. I’m proud to be part of this movement for change, for a society that puts people over profit.”

I hope you’ll take a moment to read his note and support our shared efforts to continue fighting for working families in Congress. — Nikki
* * *
Dear friends, my name is Frank, and I’m running for re-election in IN-01, a district Republicans have listed as one of their top targets to flip in 2024. In a moment, [**I’m going to humbly ask you to pitch in to support my campaign and Nikki ahead of Thursday's fundraising deadline**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68879255/424396285/968716783?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20230829_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNWU3MjdjZi1hYTQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JUWijGc3vI-5AGQk_Zx_TgKbCL4UoOZ2K7mRicXJYAA=), but first, I want to tell you a little about my background. That's what I strive to do every day on behalf of Indiana's First District. We’ve seen such an outpouring of support from the communities of CA-12.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=99%2E1163%2EfCeG37)
Hi there,
We’ve seen such an outpouring of support from the communities of CA-12, and we couldn’t be more grateful and proud.
**As you may have heard, August 31st is our deadline to reach our fundraising goal for the month.[We’ll explain why that’s important in a moment, but if you’re ready to help us make a big splash after this deadline, you can chip in here.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230829?amount=10&refcode=em20230829-1&refcode2=99_1163_fCeG37&akid=99%2E1163%2EfCeG37)**
So, why is every monthly goal so important? We set each goal intentionally every month because this campaign is fueled by grassroots contributions — and we’ll need the funds to make our campaign strategy a reality.
The amount that we raise this month will guide our long-term strategic planning. Decisions about the staff and volunteers we can support, the ads we can run, and the events we can hold for months down the line are planned out based on how we do each month.
We’re so grateful for every person who chips in — it’s how we’re able to build enough grassroots power to make sure Lateefah wins and brings every one of our voices with her to Washington. **But to reach our goal, we need a surge of contributions in the final days of this month.**
**[So, with all that in mind, what do you say? Can you chip in anything before MIDNIGHT on August 31st so we’re able to keep up our campaign’s momentum?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230829?amount=10&refcode=em20230829-1&refcode2=99_1163_fCeG37&akid=99%2E1163%2EfCeG37)**
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230829?refcode=em20230829-1&refcode2=99_1163_fCeG37&akid=99%2E1163%2EfCeG37)**
We’re thankful to you for being part of this movement – and if you’re not able to chip in right now, thank you for reading updates from Lateefah and the team.
Thank you!!
Team Lateefah
P.S. One of the most powerful ways you can support our movement is by making a recurring monthly donation, so we can plan our campaign from now all the way to Election Day. **[If you can, we’d appreciate a recurring monthly donation of any amount!**](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/378?refcode=em20230829-1&t=2&akid=99%2E1163%2EfCeG37)
* * *

Fellow Conservative,

The frustrating part about politics is these career politicians tend to stay in office so long that they lose touch with the people who sent them there in the first place.

That’s exactly what happened to Montana’s liberal U.S. Senator Jon Tester – **who as it happens is also my opponent in the U. S. Senate race.**

For a quarter of a century Senator Tester has spent his life in politics, and that has changed him...

Not only does Jon Tester vote with President Biden’s agenda 91% of the time (**out of 723 votes on nominations and legislation, Sen. Tester has voted against Biden just SIX TIMES**), but he’s also been on the wrong side of some of the most consequential issues:
* **Failing to secure our southern border**
* Supporting radical job-killing Green New Deal policies
* **Permanently protecting the right to an abortion until the moment of birth**
* Killing the Keystone XL pipeline
* Opposing constitutional Supreme Court nominees

| | The GOP is _**desperate_** to win the 2024 presidential election.

In fact, they’re so desperate that they’re willing to launch a baseless, sham impeachment against President Biden.

GOP Speaker Kevin McCarthy just said he wants to impeach President Biden – his only issue is that _he can’t find anything to impeach President Biden FOR._

**McCarthy can’t even articulate WHY he would try to impeach President Biden.** But we know why: the GOP cares more about scoring cheap political points than governing.

While Democrats stay laser-focused on lowering health care costs, fighting inflation, and keeping our economy humming, Republicans are threatening to abuse their power with sham impeachments.

---
| | Dear Peter,
---
| In the most watched interview in history, President Trump said his NUMBER ONE ISSUE is the BORDER. _I couldn’t agree more!_

In contrast, the Biden Admin is deceptively boasting there’s a decrease in illegal border crossings since Title 42 was lifted. _But we have to examine the truth behind the numbers_.

**The Biden Admin has effectively turned illegal entry into a massive "asylum claim" system. **
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fcc3d4d56d2b95c7d6dfed110&id=5aac860aa9&e=c982eb7ad4)
---
| This strategy involves encouraging foreigners to apply for asylum claims through a smartphone application before crossing into the U.S.

By utilizing the CBP One app, foreigners can schedule asylum claim appointments and then enter the nation at a port of entry. The Biden Admin announced that if people are caught entering the nation without a CPB One appointment, they cannot claim asylum unless children are with them. _So guess what, a huge increase of people with children have entered and then been released into our nation!_

This strategy, intended to make illegal immigration appear "legal," has backfired, giving rise to a surge of foreigners seeking to exploit the system.

A former CBP Commissioner recently testified before Congress that _**“what we are experiencing is the worst self-inflicted border patrol crisis that we have experienced.”**_ AZ Sheriff Mark Daniels from Cochise County, AZ testified _**“the southwest border represents the world’s largest crime scene.”**_
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fcc3d4d56d2b95c7d6dfed110&id=a3e21036d3&e=c982eb7ad4)
---
| RINO Tony Gonzales has been arguing against Republican attempts to secure our border, _siding with migrants and their ability to claim asylum_. **Tony got what he wanted: countless asylum seekers in our nation!**

**As your Congresswoman, I will fight non-stop to address this border crisis. **

**The police code for a CRIME IN PROGRESS is 10-31.** [**Peter, join me in the pursuit to address the CRIME SCENE underway at our southern border!**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fcc3d4d56d2b95c7d6dfed110&id=5f15c72160&e=c982eb7ad4)

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Since I took office as Governor, Florida now: Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC; Ranks number one for new business formations; Ranks number one for net in-migration; Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states; Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York; Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report; Has NO state income tax; Has a crime rate at a 50-year low. I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom. | But here's the problem, Peter. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud. | Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW. | | | I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage on August 23rd and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. Starting on Day One as President of the United States, these are just some of the plans I am promising to you: | | | Peter, together, we will restore sanity to our society, normalcy to our communities, and integrity to our institutions. | I stood up for the needs of the American people on the debate stage, and I made sure you know that I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. "Please, join me in fighting for the future—because freedom is always worth fighting for." In Freedom, | Ron DeSantis | Meet Ron DeSantis | | | | | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. clean_body: Ayanna is focused on dismantling systems of oppression and advancing racial justice. | | | Friend, My sister in service Ayanna Pressley is one of the strongest champions for racial justice in Congress today. She’s bold. She’s effective. She’s committed. And that’s why clout-chasing Republican presidential candidates are attacking her. Let me be clear: when someone calls a Black Congresswoman a leader of the modern KKK, not only are they obviously wrong but they are also wielding deeply dangerous rhetoric, the kind of rhetoric that has cost Black folks their lives. It would be laughable if it weren’t so serious. They’re trying to stir up animosity, seed violence, and get their faces on the news―any way they can. My Squad sisters and I have been targets of white supremacist hate for years, and I always say we must outwork the hate. I know Ayanna will never back down in advocating and legislating to dismantle systems of oppression and advance racial equity. I also know that next year, Mitch McConnell and the GOP are going to do everything they can to take back Senate control by trying to defeat Bob and flip Pennsylvania red. In fact, right now the other side is “aggressively recruiting” a mega-millionaire hedge fund executive who lives in Connecticut to run against Bob. We need to take this seriously, because this candidate has the ability to self-fund the race and outspend us. Now more than ever, we need to stand with Bob as he heads into what will be his most competitive and expensive election yet. Bob is relying on this grassroots team to have his back, so I'm reaching out to ask you directly: Thanks for doing your part, Mark Kelly

subject: An inside look on our candidate recruitment 👀
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hi Peter! I wanted
to personally reach out to share an update on our candidate recruitment
efforts for this 2024 cycle.

But first, I want to thank you for being a part of this organization. We
don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, so your support means a whole lot
to us, especially now as it’s a tough time financially for many grassroots
organizations and nonprofits.

Now, to share some updates about what we’re focused on right now. We have
been laser focused on candidate recruitment:

* Last cycle, we spoke with 3,990 local leaders about our races and
vetted 1,653 potential candidates to ensure we backed the best
possible leaders. This is what we are in the middle of doing right
now!

But, unfortunately, when our work and need for resources is ramping up –
donations to JD have slowed down. Last month, we needed to conduct layoffs
and the future of our work depends on our ability to fundraise.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137506?refcode=em20230829-30606&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq ]Will you rush a $3 contribution right now to support our
candidate recruitment efforts to ensure we have the resources to recruit
the next AOC?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137506?refcode=em20230829-30606&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq ]Contribute $3

AOC in 2018; Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush in 2020; and most recently Summer
Lee in 2022 all came out of our candidate recruitment program. And
everyday we are talking to potential candidates who could join them and
the rest of the squad in 2024 and beyond!

But it can only happen if we are able to reach our fundraising goals.

We need to raise $87,000 by the end of this month and are asking everyone
who cares about JD’s existence to chip in whatever they can. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137506?refcode=em20230829-30606&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq ]Will you
make your best gift right now?

Thank you so much for your support,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1022&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1023&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20230829-30606-footer&t=1024&refcode2=30606_1203867_szjdrq&akid=30606%2E1203867%2Eszjdrq

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. subject: I think like a scientist in Congress

**Derek, science and politics aren’t as different as they may seem.**
No matter what hat I’ve worn throughout my life – whether as an engineering student at Stanford, as a captain in the Air Force, or as a chemistry teacher in North Philadelphia – I’ve stuck to the same scientific process: I look at the facts and work together with my colleagues to reach practical, commonsense solutions.
**So, in Congress, I’ve taken that same scientific approach – and I’ve been able to solve difficult problems with Representatives across the political spectrum:**
• I currently co-chair the Climate Solutions Caucus – the only bipartisan committee working to address the effects of climate change.

• I helped launch the **first-ever Women in STEM Caucus** to support women pursuing STEM careers.

• I helped to pass the******Inflation Reduction Act** , which is expected to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 40% by 2030.
But right now, too many Republicans choose to ignore facts and data. They’d rather play politics than work to solve the problems that matter most to their constituents.

Gretchen has been a tireless advocate for Michiganders, from fighting to protect access to our fundamental freedoms, to fighting to bring good-paying jobs and the supply chain home. As Governor, she is committed to putting Michiganders first. 2. But the truth is, Gretchen’s critical work fighting for Michigan families has caught the attention of far-right extremists threatening our shared values every day. 3. Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is quickly approaching, and we’re still short of hitting our goal. # BILL EIGEL ANNOUNCES CAMPAIGN LAUNCH AND SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT ON SEPTEMBER 8TH IN ST CHARLES, MISSOURI -- RSVP NOW!
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| On September 8th, I will formally announce my candidacy intentions for 2024. I am inviting you to JOIN ME for this SPECIAL CAMPAIGN ANNOUNCEMENT!

**_*RSVP for launch_** [**_here_**](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=2176752ce8&e=c00a6982d2)** _*_**

Missouri is short on leadership. The Show-Me State has stagnated economically and fallen behind other big red conservative states because of a Swamp in Jefferson City that refuses to accomplish what the People desperately need. Our culture is in the midst of a war of ideas on the role of government—we need a wartime leader with the backbone and willingness to take on the powerful special interests in our state that are profiting at the expense of the People. I will be that leader, and unlike many politicians, I've **always** done what I said I was going to do.

**_*RSVP for launch_** [**_here_**](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=7982a23378&e=c00a6982d2)** _*_**

The Eigel for Governor Exploratory campaign started in October 2022 to determine if sufficient support and interest existed to elect a bold, conservative reformer. By every metric we set since October of 2022, we have seen an unbelievable response from the People of Missouri. Our exploratory campaign has garnered [national attention](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=45990af42f&e=c00a6982d2) for our small dollar fundraising network. In the second quarter of 2023, Eigel received more than 41,000 donations from over 20,000 donors. At an average donation of under $20, this represents more single donations than ANY other candidate running for the Republican gubernatorial nomination in their state anywhere in the United States for 2024.

**_*RSVP for launch_** [**_here_**](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=97f0a3bcc0&e=c00a6982d2)** _*_**

It's time for a reckoning for the Jefferson City Swamp; I will be that reckoning.

The event on September 8th will be held at Smartt Field at the St. Charles County Regional Airport. Tickets to the event are **FREE** **but[you must RSVP.](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=0724ff108b&e=c00a6982d2) Doors open at 4:30pm!**

**_*RSVP for launch_** [**_h_**](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=fb00de3a94&e=c00a6982d2)**[ _ere_](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=50f3218abe&e=c00a6982d2)**** _* or _****send an email to [mofreedom2024@gmail.com](mailto:mofreedom2024@gmail.com)**** stating your: Name, Email, Contact Phone, and Address**

**LET'S GO MISSOURI!**

Can I tell you something, Fellow American?

**My district leans Republican.**

_We were represented by Republicans for twenty years._

But then Democrats pulled a fast one. They redrew our district lines in the middle of the cycle, using the courts to gerrymander Pennsylvania before the “Blue Wave” election in 2018.

The result? We’re now represented by a radical progressive named Susan Wild.

Where does that leave us?

**_The experts say this is the most competitive district in the most competitive state in America – the one most likely to decide the Presidency in 2024._**

[**It is time for change. As a ninth-generation resident of the Greater Lehigh Valley, I’m the man for the job... and I have the record to prove it.**](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=886d6bb5c1f34450adb07c9680618f12&_e=bjjQq-kE2DcKlZD2VtPoaHcUrUPa0xw0CHyG21EXFv4cdjQltlKYtutURKuOdoZ7Sn42jFVMRRW3ocNDO48TsWHtCZ3LOWj92JTsjku0vwlpSS2TFZldRvfnqGpTzYzH547VX8LikgrC506oJ55Qx2SGnPr8VdWk3Li_TtukXu5nNQIVvXgfmpGAiwM5c1uTm3X9NHvsnmTM6RtT1imacfKKSPhFKvB1-6AsPkAC8jXbu4Na1QgaifqMiQ5Wujt3rQHmuDVTjVrsRK7AB0emhNRtLqXxHZHTeaq-zbvVAMO9o7P2y3EiEZmHe9-99YsVA9OF1OgG7oBNEEJhWVEAdkEBqphF5CZ1CmlNLAZMfSphvgMijNb6CKO44UPhrR9-DiQPlovk992Z7_IQZWDrNA%3D%3D)

[ **HELP RYAN FLIP A CONSERVATIVE BLUE SEAT**](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=886d6bb5c1f34450adb07c9680618f12&_e=bjjQq-kE2DcKlZD2VtPoaHcUrUPa0xw0CHyG21EXFv4cdjQltlKYtutURKuOdoZ7Sn42jFVMRRW3ocNDO48TsWHtCZ3LOWj92JTsjku0vwlpSS2TFZldRvfnqGpTzYzH547VX8LikgrC506oJ55Qx2SGnPr8VdWk3Li_TtukXu5nNQIVvXgfmpGAiwM5c1uTm3X9NHvsnmTM6RtT1imacfKKSPhFKvB1-6AsPkAC8jXX6kosUHOxZ4r7-KcC8TcJWb-2qkdArhBauGmwhFRHg23ZbqNIh8dLj1co5XtCUaaomjf-lVZVv5I5o1r7Mg00vOLyZxoCxBH9m1_aUKind4mVpF7EHtDC0-TilabbmuA0cTe6RB5_HLFvxUzTXo0TseoM-v-KyxoDNbdUnHx7Aw%3D%3D)

I’ve worked for the people of Pennsylvania for years as a State Representative, and I’ve _consistently_ delivered results. I’ve _always_ put America First. Here are just a few ways:

body:
|
#
---
Team — my name is Yadira Caraveo, and after winning in one of the closest races in the country, I now proudly represent Colorado’s 8th district in Congress. Jason told me to reach out. I wanted to share a little bit about my story, and why I’m in this fight. [_**I hope you’ll take a moment to read this message, but if you’re already with me, will you chip in to my reelection campaign and support Jason Crow?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68884165/424412615/41762826?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20230829_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk4YTg5Ny1iYjQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-tCpeRi5X9TtANt2LwoLaFHBZWL7ySnwlNxGWqFwOpc=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68884166/424412617/41762826?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20230829_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk4YTg5Ny1iYjQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-tCpeRi5X9TtANt2LwoLaFHBZWL7ySnwlNxGWqFwOpc=) **Family means everything to me.** My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my siblings with those values — on a construction worker’s pay in the Adams County home they still live in. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68884174/424412618/41762826?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20230829_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk4YTg5Ny1iYjQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-tCpeRi5X9TtANt2LwoLaFHBZWL7ySnwlNxGWqFwOpc=) **I put myself through undergrad and medical school, becoming the first person in my family to graduate from college.** But even before I finished my medical training, advocacy became an important part of my life. I helped organize my fellow medical residents for better working conditions, and became a union representative with SEIU. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68884178/424412628/41762826?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20230829_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk4YTg5Ny1iYjQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-tCpeRi5X9TtANt2LwoLaFHBZWL7ySnwlNxGWqFwOpc=) I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community – to the folks that raised me. **But I quickly understood that truly helping children required a lot more than what I was able to do as a doctor.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68884179/424412632/41762826?refcode=AU_JC_FR_TAN_EOM_AC30_20230829_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDk4YTg5Ny1iYjQ2LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-tCpeRi5X9TtANt2LwoLaFHBZWL7ySnwlNxGWqFwOpc=) **That’s why I ran for the state legislature.** In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic. And, team, that’s why I ran for Congress in 2022. The pollsters said I had a 9% shot of winning this race. Thanks to grassroots Democrats like you, we defied the odds, elected the first Latina from Colorado to Congress, and had the best midterm performance with a Democratic president in modern history. I promise you that I will continue my commitment to the families I see every day in Colorado. I will build on my work to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my siblings with those values — on a construction worker’s pay in the Adams County home they still live in. = I put myself through undergrad and medical school, becoming the first person in my family to graduate from college. But even before I finished my medical training, advocacy became an important part of my life. I helped organize my fellow medical residents for better working conditions, and became a union representative with SEIU. = I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community – to the folks that raised me. But I quickly understood that truly helping children required a lot more than what I was able to do as a doctor. = That’s why I ran for the state legislature. In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic. And, team, that’s why I ran for Congress in 2022. The pollsters said I had a 9% shot of winning this race. From an early age, my family instilled three principles in me: service, struggle, and sacrifice.

My grandmother immigrated to New York to pursue the American dream. Both sets of grandparents struggled and sacrificed to provide opportunities for their kids. My father worked in the garment industry before it collapsed and he had to start over. My mother was an educator who turned into a caretaker when some of her closest friends fell ill to cancer, all while dealing with her own chronic health issues. These are the people who have taught me everything — how to work hard, to care for others, and to give back to the community that gave to you.

I have spent the last four years defeating MAGA extremists across the country in some of the most competitive districts and states with my organization, The Next 50. Now, I am stepping up to run myself and defeat George Santos so we can restore integrity and pride in our district.

We fully expect them to spend millions of dollars more than this district has ever received to hold on to this seat. **And that is why I need you, Peter.**

if you don’t get involved in this race soon, we may not have a chance to win back the Senate. | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=214711ad81b746bea73a077df3e6eed0&_e=fx3d-e7jo73g7ChHpWIflvJZw-do_sSXI3qQOUb1-Fa2WbKY5B3IYYbUA5bFjg4FPuvaH7eNA2RkWBEV2hgSsja27Y8jg3ahlOMLJ0SkwTq-LctIz55QsDLwW_MNOH3xGA4rMkrROp2DJlnPmCgo_u7qTr9TgaS_OwhmIizJYStT8ComzZBTUOwNaiemKhLg1RxvtUtQBTYFHwSAOj-j9FtfPmAA7hUFTJ7LWHSIxxGDx563_4inqlOvVtz1-VBhWDAXSKg5v3NXPpJdN7RiBAuVyiI9CgGNiVBzHSSVhckqKnrIlRFZjpwboEKi2zj06vf6dENtr5WuFMW_XBpwW-0b1rlVbhQCapG2LX1FPAX6VmOuwnWq1hPalZaWkbinupzxZR2Okq1CrvgCFcZkbN5NihglLSpEQzj8OFrUiSlAwxJESzSi7Cf-D_2zFdKv-PBGP3FqicwahWRpol2Xjw%3D%3D)

Fellow American,

It’s Senator Ted Cruz with a serious message for you today: Democrats are coming for me like they’ve never gone after anyone before; they want me gone. We cannot give them the satisfaction of defeating me, no matter what.

I’m desperately in need of your help. I’m fighting a war on two fronts.

Friend,

**I can never forget what happened on October 25, 2012.**

We were minding our own business, Fred and I, on Highway 136, south of Dyersville, when a deer popped out of nowhere, hit our bumper, and scared the living daylights out of us.

It all happened in the blink of an eye. We came to a screeching halt, and the silence after the collision was deafening. We had no choice but to get out and assess the situation. When we got out to check the damage, nothing was left behind. Just some bumps on the fender, the deer vanished, and we had only one conclusion.

Assume deer dead.

body:
We had to make a pretty difficult decision, and we thought you should know about it.
#

Hey there, Peter, it's Ruben Gallego's campaign again.
We had to make a pretty difficult decision earlier today, and we thought you should know about it.
We're at the point of the race where we expect Kari Lake to jump in any day. And when we look back at the last Senate race in Arizona, this is also around the time Republicans started running attack ads to weaken Mark Kelly even though they didn't have a nominee yet.
We have to be ready for that, and, without saying too much, there are a number of investments we have to make in order to be prepared. Because getting caught off guard and letting Republicans attack Ruben would be trouble.
The money wasn't in the budget, but Ruben gave the green light, even though we are short of our goals ahead of our deadline. A deadline that ends in two days.
Ruben was banking on the fact that if we told you this, and if we asked, you would help fill the gap. And we're really hoping you can. For Ruben. And for everyone who knows we must replace Kyrsten Sinema and beat Kari Lake.
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Ruben Gallego's campaign for Senate today? Every donation will help fill the budget gap we created ahead of our August fundraising deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-aug23.NWxa9e&refcode=em230829-2-f&t=1&akid=1062%2E734936%2EoF6V_S)
Like we said, this was not an easy decision. But if there’s one thing that sets our campaign apart from all the others in this race, it’s the fact that we’re funded by people like you, doing what you can, when you can.

His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. | I'll be honest, folks—

Fundraising is one of the worst parts of this job, **but just a few moments from now I’ll have to ask you to make a donation.**

I do it because national Republicans and out-of-state super PACs are pledging to spend outrageous amounts of money to attack my character and **the only chance we have to respond is by collecting grassroots donations from a whole lot of people.**

_Folks, my opponents will try to turn me into someone I'm not, because they can’t beat who I am._

I’m a third-generation farmer, the Senate’s only working dirt farmer, and I’ll never stop fighting for the hardworking people that call Montana home.

**Since we officially launched my reelection campaign, tens of thousands of people all over the country have chipped in to support us.** That’s something I’m proud of, and it means that I’ll have a fighting chance to stand up to the millions of dollars the GOP will spend against me.

**But we can’t slow down, not even for a minute, because experts are already saying that this will be the most expensive election in Montana’s history.**

I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.

Ted Cruz’s false claims about the 2020 election helped incite the insurrection. That's Ted for you: All hat, no cattle.

That day is one of many, many reasons I know Ted Cruz has got to go. People lost their lives, and our government came the closest it ever has to crumbling. His MAGA extremism is bad for Texas and our country, and it’s time to hold him accountable.

body:
Grassroots donors just like you power our campaign.
#
Derek, we’re sure you’re busy -- so let us quickly explain why we’re reaching out with this message + **[asking for your contribution to power our work before our end-of-month deadline.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230829-2?refcode=em20230829-2-8530&refcode2=8530_434096_baiKVe&akid=8530%2E434096%2EbaiKVe)**
Grassroots donors just like you power our campaign and were how we flipped PA blue 🔵 and sent John to the Senate. We seriously couldn’t have done it without your help.
But we can’t take our foot off the gas. **Commentators on the far-right are *still* coming after John with personal attacks -- and worse, doing the same to his family, too.** These personal attacks are cheap shots to distract from what the GOP is really trying to do. We think it’s part of their plan to rile up the right-wing base and flip the Senate red 🔴 so they can start their extreme agenda: cutting Medicare and Social Security and even enacting a national abortion ban.
**John is up for this fight, but he needs each of us in his corner.** We’ve got to get a flood of grassroots $$$ before the end of the month to be able to support his work in the Senate.
**[So if you’re able to, we hope you’ll consider donating $5 before our August 31 deadline to keep up the fight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230829-2?refcode=em20230829-2-8530&refcode2=8530_434096_baiKVe&akid=8530%2E434096%2EbaiKVe)**
